# Amendments
Every deviation from docs/architecture or docs/plan is recorded here before or with the change. Newest last.

Format:
## A-NNN YYYY-MM-DD <task-id>: <title>
- Change: what is different from the spec
- Reason: evidence (numbers, errors, API facts)
- Impact: affected docs sections and task ids (updated in the same commit)

## A-001 2026-09-27 P00-T03: detekt 2.0 alpha and hilt-lifecycle-viewmodel-compose
- Change: detekt pinned to 2.0.0-alpha.6 (plugin id `dev.detekt`) instead of a stable release; `androidx.hilt:hilt-lifecycle-viewmodel-compose` replaces `hilt-navigation-compose`.
- Reason: the latest compose-rules (io.nlopez.compose.rules:detekt 0.6.7) depends on dev.detekt:detekt-core 2.0.0-alpha.6 (its POM); the only stable detekt (1.23.8) is built on Kotlin 2.0.21 while the project uses Kotlin 2.4.20 and AGP 9. With Navigation 3 (stable 1.2.0, ADR-013) `hiltViewModel()` lives in hilt-lifecycle-viewmodel-compose; hilt-navigation-compose targets navigation-compose. detekt is build-time only, nothing ships.
- Impact: 02-modules.md#dependencies (DI and Quality rows), decisions.md ADR-012 note, .claude/rules/gradle.md alpha list. Revisit when detekt 2.0.0 is stable.

## A-002 2026-09-27 P00-T04: core:common and core:testing are JVM modules; bytecode 17 without a toolchain
- Change: `core:common` and `core:testing` are Kotlin/JVM modules (spec: Android libraries). `core:testing -> core:model, core:common` is an allowed edge (test-only consumer). No Gradle JVM toolchain: JDK 21 runs the build, bytecode target is 17 via compileOptions / jvmTarget / `--release 17`. build-tools pinned to the installed 37.0.0; compileSdk 37 minor 2.
- Reason: `core:model` and `core:format` are JVM modules and must depend on `core:common` and use `core:testing` in tests; a JVM module cannot depend on an Android library. Both modules only hold pure Kotlin APIs (Android sinks for FolioLog/PerfMonitor tracing live in :app). A toolchain of 17 needs a JDK 17 install or network auto-provisioning; only JDK 21 is installed (env.md). AGP 9.4.1 defaults to build-tools 36.0.0, which is not installed and would trigger a license-bearing download.
- Impact: 02-modules.md#module-list and graph; root `verifyModuleGraph` encodes the graph.

## A-003 2026-09-27 P00-T06: PerfMonitor traces through a TraceSink; Roborazzi plugin via build-logic
- Change: `PerfMonitor` (JVM core:common) emits trace sections through a `TraceSink` interface; :app installs a sink backed by platform `android.os.Trace` instead of androidx.tracing. Release keeps only the trace calls (`PerfMonitor.enabled = BuildConfig.DEBUG`). The Roborazzi Gradle plugin is loaded from build-logic's classpath (Maven Central artifact) instead of the `plugins {}` block.
- Reason: androidx.tracing 2.0.3 reworked its API; the platform Trace (minSdk 35) produces the same Perfetto/atrace sections without an extra dependency and keeps core:common Android-free (A-002). Roborazzi publishes its plugin marker only to the Gradle Plugin Portal, which the build does not use (repositories: google, mavenCentral).
- Impact: 12-performance.md#measurement; tracing-ktx stays in the catalog unused until a module needs it.

## A-004 2026-09-27 P00-REVIEW: qa task layout; test-only EPL-1.0 allowed
- Change: `qa` is layered: each module gets `qa` from `folio.quality`, `verifyNoInternet<Variant>` tasks come from `folio.android.application` (including the androidTest APK manifest), and the root `qa`/`verifyNoInternet` aggregate them (spec: both live in the root build). The gradle rule's license list allows EPL-1.0 for test-only artifacts.
- Reason: per-module tasks keep module builds independent (configuration cache, project isolation later); the root task depends on every module `qa` explicitly (reviewer finding). JUnit4 (EPL-1.0) is required by the testing rule and 02-modules.md#dependencies but never ships in an APK; `verifyModuleGraph` keeps core:testing out of non-test configurations.
- Impact: 02-modules.md#build-logic, .claude/rules/gradle.md.

## A-005 2026-09-27 P01-S1: dry handoff waits for the frame-commit callback
- Change: step 3 of the dry handoff removes finished wet strokes in a `ViewTreeObserver.registerFrameCommitCallback` callback instead of a `Choreographer` frame callback. `DisplayModeHelper` (core:render) exists from P01-S1; P03 wires it into the canvas host.
- Reason: a frame callback posted after `invalidate()` runs in the animation phase of the same vsync, before that frame's draw, so it removes wet ink before the committed layer has drawn it (breaks "never remove earlier"). The commit callback fires after the frame is submitted: `ink:handoff` p50 6.4 ms (about one 120 Hz frame), all post-stroke screenshots clean (decisions.md ADR-002 evidence).
- Impact: 05-canvas-rendering.md#dry-handoff; P03 canvas host tasks (dry handoff, DisplayModeHelper).

## A-006 2026-09-27 P01-S3: grid-pitch reference scale and measured baseline correction
- Change: the line-box layout uses a reference scale r = round(4*U)/U px per pt (one grid unit = whole px) instead of a fixed 4 px per pt, and shifts each block by `k*U*r - firstLineBaseline` from the layout result instead of the font descent from `FontMetricsCache`. Bundled fonts: 37 files (variable where Google publishes them), about 28 MB.
- Reason: Robolectric native-graphics probe, 20 fonts x 3 paragraphs, U = 7.1 mm: the descent shift missed rules by 0.64 to 10.35 px at zoom 1 (2.6 to 41 px at zoom 4) because `LineHeightStyle` rounds each line height up to whole px (80.5 -> 81 px: 0.125 pt drift per line) and layout baselines are whole px. The grid-pitch variant put every baseline on its rule (0.000 px at zoom 1, 2, 4). Confirmed on the Pad 7 (P01-S3b): identical numbers.
- Impact: 07-text-engine.md#line-box, decisions.md ADR-008; P06-T02 (`FontMetricsCache` no longer feeds placement), P06-T03 (`BlockLayout` uses the grid-pitch scale per U).

## A-007 2026-09-27 P01-S4: LaTeX via jlatexmath-android instead of RaTeX
- Change: ADR-007 picks option C (jlatexmath-android 0.2.0) instead of the default A (RaTeX); the RaTeX dependency is removed by P01-T08. `MathBox` gets 0.04 em padding on every side (P01-T08: `\vec` arrows also overshoot sideways).
- Reason: device probe, 40 formulas: RaTeX 100% parsed but layout+draw p95 5.09 ms (budget 4 ms); jlatexmath 97.5% parsed (no `\ce`), p95 0.80 ms, vector PDF output. Both draw up to 1.6 / 1.9 px outside their reported box at 50 px.
- Impact: 07-text-engine.md#math, decisions.md ADR-007, docs/notes/env.md; P06-T07 (math adapter, padding, no mhchem support in the corpus tests).

## A-008 2026-09-28 P01-T08: spike results carried into later phases
- Change: promoted and kept: `FontRegistry` + 20 bundled fonts, `FontMetricsCache`, `GridTextLayouter` (core:text), `MathRenderer` + `JLatexMathRenderer` (core:text math), `PdfBoxOverlayMerger` (core:pdf); app packages arm64-v8a only. Deleted: tile, IO and PDF probe code, RaTeX. Kept temporarily (Deferred D-002): the debug routes `spike-ink`, `spike-fonts`, `spike-stylus` with their probe code (app spikes/, core:text spike/) because open USER-CHECKs (P01-S1, S3, S7) need them on the tablet.
- Reason: phase-01 exit says spike code is deleted or promoted; three screens are still the only way to answer the USER-CHECKs. The removal duty was added to the P03-T09 and P06-T03 task blocks (P01 REVIEW).
- Impact: P03 (tiles use bitmap strategy A, ADR-003; `StylusCapabilities` defaults from device.md#stylus; P03-T09 removes `spike-ink` and `spike-stylus` after the USER-CHECKs), P02 packer (write protocol measured, ADR-004), P06-T02 (FontRegistry and FontMetricsCache exist), P06-T03 (seed: GridTextLayouter, BaselineProbe tests become the regression suite, then `spike-fonts` goes), P06-T07 (JLatexMathRenderer exists), P09 export (merger exists).

## A-009 2026-09-28 P02-T01: loaded page bodies live in Document.pageBodies
- Change: `Document` gets `pageBodies: PersistentMap<PageId, Page>` (decoded bodies held by the session); `PageRef` carries `contentBounds`. Object commands require the body of their page to be loaded; the session loads bodies before executing and evicts only clean, unreferenced ones (LRU 30). Geometry adds `RectPt.distanceTo`, `offset`, `Affine.after`; rect edges are inclusive and `RectPt.EMPTY` is the union identity. Detekt `MagicNumber.ignoreEnums = true`.
- Reason: 03-document-model.md had `EditCommand.execute(doc)` but no place for decoded page bodies in `Document`; keeping them in the immutable state keeps commands pure and undo inverses exact without a second mutable page store.
- Impact: 03-document-model.md#document; P02-T02 commands, P02-T09 session (page cache = `pageBodies` + LRU bookkeeping).

## A-010 2026-09-28 P02-T02: exact-inverse helper commands, UpdateFlows/UpdateAssets, requiredPages
- Change: besides the listed commands, core:model has `InsertObjectsAt`, `UpdateObjects`, `SetObjectOrder`, `RestorePages`, `SetPageOrder` (used as exact inverses), `UpdateFlows(put, remove)` (flow create/delete/style; not in the spec list) and `UpdateAssets(put, remove)` instead of `AddAsset`. `EditFlow` carries text range edits. Commands expose `requiredPages` and `coalesceKey`. `UndoManager` takes the injected `Clock` (monotonic time for the 1000 ms window) and exposes `nextUndo`/`nextRedo`. core:testing depends on core:model (`ModelFixtures`), allowed by architecture-boundaries.
- Reason: inverse commands computed from float math (inverse affine, index arithmetic) would not restore the document exactly; the 200-command property test demands equality. Text boxes and sticky notes need flow creation and deletion as undoable steps.
- Impact: 03-document-model.md#commands-and-undo; P06 (block edits map to `TextEdit` ranges), P07 (lasso, recolor), P02-T09 (session loads `requiredPages` before execute/undo/redo).

## A-011 2026-09-28 P02-T04: manifest page summaries carry the full background
- Change: manifest pages and `defaults` get the additive keys `background` and `origin` (infinite pages); container code is `FolioEntries` (names, order, STORED rule), `EntryReader` (implemented by `FolioContainerReader` over ZipFile and later by the working copy), `DocumentCodec` (read) and `DocumentEntries` (write). Migrations rewrite the manifest JSON (`Migration.migrateManifest`); page-payload migrations get added with the first v2 change.
- Reason: `PageRef` holds spec + full background (03-document-model.md#document) and must be built from the manifest alone; the documented summary had only the template kind.
- Impact: 04-file-format.md#manifest; P02-T05 (working copy implements `EntryReader`), P02-T07 scanner (reads manifest only).

## A-012 2026-09-28 P02-T05: streaming FolioFs, backup of the opened version, JavaFileFolioFs in core:common
- Change: `FolioFs` gains `stat`, `openRead`, `writeAtomic(path) { out -> }` (atomic streaming write incl. directory fsync) and `deleteRecursively`; the java.io implementation `JavaFileFolioFs` lives in core:common (P02-T06 listed it in core:storage) and backs `TempDirFolioFs`. The packer copies the source to `files/backup/<docId>.folio` once per working copy, before its first replacement, instead of "after the rename". Unpacking streams the ZIP (`ZipInputStream`) through `FolioFs`, 8 GB total bound. Detekt: `TooManyFunctions.ignoreOverridden`, `ReturnCount.excludeGuardClauses`.
- Reason: packs of 50 MB documents cannot go through in-memory `readBytes`/`writeBytesAtomic`; after the rename the previous version no longer exists, so the backup has to be taken before, and once per editing session keeps it cheap (one extra copy) and more useful (state before the session).
- Impact: 04-file-format.md#write-protocol; P02-T06 (uses `JavaFileFolioFs` for the library root), P02-T09 session (flush autosaver, then pack, under one mutex).

## A-013 2026-09-28 P02-T07: index keyed by path; FolioFs.localFile
- Change: `documents` has primary key `path` (docId indexed), `tags`/`links` reference the document path with cascading deletes, `doc_fts` stores the path (unicode61 tokenizer for umlauts). Moves are a delete plus insert of the same docId. `FolioFs.localFile(path)` exposes the java.io.File for ZipFile random access. The scanner also deletes hidden `*.folio*.tmp` files older than 10 minutes (crash recovery). Build: the Robolectric JDK 21 `--add-opens` flags moved from the screenshot plugin to every Android module's unit tests.
- Reason: 09-storage-library.md keeps both rows for duplicated docIds, which a docId primary key cannot hold; the scan budget needs random access (manifest + search text only) rather than streaming whole ZIPs.
- Impact: 09-storage-library.md#index; P02-T08 repositories (resolve by docId via `documentsById`, rank title hits first in Kotlin), P05 library UI.

## A-014 2026-09-28 P02-T08: repository details
- Change: repositories address documents by library path; metadata edits of closed documents rewrite the container with a JSON-level manifest patch (`ManifestPatch`); duplicates take the new file name as title; `LibraryRepository` also owns folder create/rename/move/tint/delete; bin state is a `StateFlow` read from `.trash` sidecars. `Clock` and `ManifestApp` are provided by :app's AppModule.
- Reason: the spec leaves title/ids of duplicates and the handling of unknown manifest keys open; a JSON patch is the only way to keep keys a newer version wrote.
- Impact: 09-storage-library.md#repositories; P05 library UI, P02-T09 session (`open`).

1	# 09 Storage and library
2	
3	## Permission
4	- The library lives in shared storage so the user can copy files over USB and other apps (R-FILE-01). Access uses `MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE` (All files access) + `java.io.File` (ADR-004). Acceptable because the app is sideloaded for personal use; SAF DocumentFile would be slow for scanning and random-access ZIP.
5	- First launch: onboarding explains the permission in two sentences and opens `Settings.ACTION_MANAGE_APP_ALL_FILES_ACCESS_PERMISSION` for our package. The library screen re-checks `Environment.isExternalStorageManager()` on every resume; if revoked, a blocking banner with the same button replaces the grid (open editors pack to the working copy only until access returns).
6	- Debug builds can be granted via `scripts/device/grant-storage.sh`.
7	- Measured (P01-S6, ADR-004): java.io on the HyperOS FUSE mount packs a 46 MB `.folio` in 1.39..1.45 s (write dominates), the tmp-fsync-rename protocol survived kills mid-pack, and FileObserver delivers external writes (e.g. over USB) as CREATE/CLOSE_WRITE.
8	
9	## Library layout
10	```
11	/sdcard/Documents/Folio/            (debug: Folio-Debug/; configurable later)
12	  Physics/                          folder = directory; nesting unlimited
13	    .folder.json                    optional: {"tint":"blue","sort":"recent"}
14	    Kinematics.folio
15	  Journal 2026.folio
16	  Exports/                          default export destination
17	  .trash/                           bin (see Trash)
18	  .templates/                       custom templates (PNG/PDF) available to all documents
19	  .fonts/                           imported custom fonts (mirrored for portability)
20	```
21	- Hidden entries (names starting with `.`) are never shown as folders. File names are derived from titles (invalid characters replaced by `-`, max 120 chars, collision suffix " (2)").
22	- Renaming a document renames the file and updates the manifest title. Moving = file move (same volume, atomic).
23	
24	## Index
25	Room database `index.db` in app-private storage. Disposable: can be deleted and rebuilt by a full scan.
26	| Table | Columns |
27	|---|---|
28	| documents | path (PK, library-relative), docId (indexed), folderPath, title, createdMs, modifiedMs, favorite, pageCount, textPreview, fileSize, fileMtime, coverThumbPath, formatVersion, status (OK, TOO_NEW, CORRUPT) |
29	| folders | path (PK), parentPath, name, tint, createdMs |
30	| tags | path (FK documents, cascade), tag (PK both) |
31	| links | fromPath (FK documents, cascade), toDocId (PK both) |
32	| doc_fts | FTS4 (unicode61 tokenizer): path (not indexed), title, body |
33	Duplicate docIds (a file copied manually): the second file gets a new docId on first open (manifest rewritten); until then the index keeps both rows, which is why rows are keyed by path (A-013). Unreadable files get a row with the file name as title and status TOO_NEW or CORRUPT.
34	
35	## Scanning
36	- Full scan: walk the root (skip hidden dirs), for each `.folio` read only `manifest.json` and `search/text.txt` via ZipFile random access, upsert rows in batched transactions (200 per transaction). Runs on first launch, when the root changes, and from Settings "Rebuild index".
37	- Incremental scan on every app foreground: compare size + mtime of each file with the index; re-read changed ones; remove rows for vanished files; detect moves by docId.
38	- Live updates while running: `FileObserver` on the currently displayed folder and on folders of open documents; our own writes update the index directly (no rescan).
39	- Budget: 500 documents full scan < 3 s on the tablet; incremental with no changes < 300 ms.
40	
41	## Repositories
42	- `LibraryRepository`: `folderTree(): Flow`, `documents(folder, filter, sort): Flow` (filters: all, favorites, tag, bin), `search(query): Flow`, `setFavorite`, `setTags`, folder CRUD (create, rename, tint, move, delete to bin).
43	- `DocumentRepository`: `create(NewDocumentSpec)`, `importPdf(uri)`, `importFolio(uri)`, `open(docId): DocumentSession`, `duplicate`, `rename`, `move`, `delete` (to bin), `restore`, `deleteForever`, `emptyBin`, `purgeBin(retention)`.
44	- All operations are suspend functions on the io dispatcher returning `Outcome`.
45	- Implementation notes (A-014): operations take library-relative paths and act on closed documents (open ones change through their session). Favorite, tags, rename and duplicate rewrite the `.folio` (all entries streamed, `manifest.json` patched as JSON so unknown keys survive; rename also rewrites the first line of `search/text.txt`). A duplicate gets a new docId and the title of its file name ("X (2)"). The bin list comes from the `.trash` sidecars, not the index. `importPdf` arrives with P08-T01, `importFolio` with the P05 New menu, `open` returns the P02-T09 session.
46	
47	## Trash
48	- Deleting a document or folder moves it to `.trash/<epochMs>__<name>` plus sidecar `<same>.trash.json` `{ "originalPath": "Physics/Kinematics.folio", "deletedMs": ..., "docId": ... }`.
49	- Bin tab lists trash entries with "deleted N days ago / M days left". Restore moves back to the original path (recreating folders; name collision -> " (2)").
50	- Retention (settings): 7, 30 (default), 90 days, never. A daily WorkManager job and every app start purge expired entries. "Delete forever" and "Empty bin" ask for confirmation.
51	- Trashed documents are excluded from search and links resolution (links show as broken).
52	
53	## Search
54	- FTS4 over title + body where body = `search/text.txt` (plain text of all flows, Markdown syntax stripped, math source kept as text). Handwriting is not searchable (R-ORG-03).
55	- Query: tokens with prefix matching (`term*`), all tokens must match. Ranking: title matches first, then by modifiedMs.
56	- Results show title, folder, snippet with highlighted matches (FTS snippet()). Opening a result jumps to the first page containing the first match (page lookup via flow layout at open).
57	- Recent searches: last 10, stored locally in DataStore.
58	
59	## Links
60	- Note links are Markdown links `[Title](folio://doc/<docUuid>)` (optionally `#page=<pageId>`). The editor inserts them via the `[[` picker (search by title).
61	- Resolution through the index by docId, so renames and moves never break links. Missing target: link rendered struck-through with a "not found" tooltip.
62	- Backlinks: `links` table filled from each manifest's `links` array (maintained at pack time from the flows). The editor's overflow menu shows "Linked from" with a list.
63	- Web links (`https://`) open via ACTION_VIEW in the user's browser (Folio itself has no network access).
64	
65	## Thumbnails
66	- Cover: first page rendered at <= 512 px long side (WebP q80), stored in the document (`thumbs/cover.webp`) at pack time and cached in app cache for the library grid.
67	- Page thumbnails: <= 256 px, generated after 2 s editing idle on the render dispatcher for pages changed since the last thumbnail; used by the page panel; stored in the document at pack time (optional entries).
68	- Text-heavy documents: the library card shows `textPreview` instead of the image when the first page's objects are mostly text frames (ratio of text frame area to object area > 0.6).

# Architecture boundaries (violations fail review)
Allowed module dependencies:
- `core:common` -> nothing internal. JVM module (A-002), no `android.*`.
- `core:model` -> core:common. JVM module, no `android.*`.
- `core:format` -> core:model, core:common. JVM module, no `android.*`.
- `core:storage` -> core:format, core:model, core:common.
- `core:ink` -> core:model, core:common.
- `core:text` -> core:model, core:common.
- `core:render` -> core:model, core:ink, core:text, core:common.
- `core:pdf` -> core:render, core:format, core:model, core:common.
- `core:designsystem` -> core:common.
- `core:testing` -> core:model, core:common. JVM module (A-002), used only via `testImplementation`.
- `feature:*` -> any core module. Never another feature.
- `app` -> everything. Contains wiring, navigation, Application, debug automation only.

Inside features: `ui/` (stateless composables) -> `state/` (ViewModel, UiState, reducers) -> core APIs.
- `EditorSession` (feature:editor) owns the document StateFlow, UndoManager, selection, tool state.
- The canvas host view talks to the session only through the narrow `CanvasController` interface. It never sees a ViewModel.
- Documents change only through `EditCommand`s executed by the session. No direct mutation, no second source of truth.
- DI: Hilt, constructor injection, one Hilt module per core library. No service locators, no global singletons outside Hilt.
- New module or new cross-module dependency: AMENDMENTS entry + update `docs/architecture/02-modules.md` first.
---
paths:
  - "core/format/**"
  - "core/storage/**"
---
# File format and storage rules
- `docs/architecture/04-file-format.md` is normative. Any format change: bump version, add migration + golden test, update the doc in the same commit.
- Wire `.proto` files in `core/format/src/main/proto/folio/v1/`. Never reuse field numbers; removed fields become `reserved`.
- All writes atomic: temp file in the same directory -> flush + fsync -> rename. Never write a user file in place.
- Working copies live in app-private `files/work/<docId>/`. Entry autosave after 1 s idle; pack on editor close, `onStop`, and every 30 s while dirty.
- Permanent deletion only via user actions (Delete forever, Empty bin) and bin auto-purge.
- Library root comes from `LibraryConfig` (release `Documents/Folio`, debug `Documents/Folio-Debug`). Never hardcode it.
- Room index is disposable: schema change = version bump + destructive migration + full rescan.
- File IO only on the io dispatcher, through the injected `FolioFs` so tests use temp dirs.
- Treat every file from the library folder as untrusted input: bounded sizes, typed errors, open corrupted files read-only with a message.
---
paths:
  - "**/*.kt"
  - "**/*.kts"
---
# Kotlin rules
- Official Kotlin style, enforced by spotless/ktlint. Run `./gradlew spotlessApply` before committing.
- Package root `dev.folio`; package mirrors module path (`:core:text` -> `dev.folio.core.text`).
- Immutable by default: `val`, data classes, `kotlinx.collections.immutable` for document state.
- No `!!` outside tests. No `lateinit` in domain code. Sealed interfaces + exhaustive `when` for variants.
- Expected failures return `Outcome<T>` (core:common). Throw only for programmer errors. Never swallow exceptions; log via `FolioLog`.
- Coroutines: inject `FolioDispatchers` (main, io, render, pdf, text). No `GlobalScope`, no `runBlocking` on main, cancellation-safe IO.
- Hot paths (input, render, text layout, typing) carry a `// HOT PATH` comment: no per-event allocation, no boxing, no logging, no Flow emission per point.
- `internal` by default; public only for cross-module API, each with a one-line KDoc.
- Units in names when ambiguous: `widthPt`, `sizePx`, `durationMs`, `angleDeg`. Page space = PDF points.
- Annotate non-obvious threading with `@MainThread` / `@WorkerThread`.
- JSON: kotlinx.serialization. Protobuf: Wire. No Gson, no Java serialization, no reflection-based mappers.
- Logging: `FolioLog.d/i/w/e(tag, msg)`. Debug and verbose logs are stripped in release via R8 rules.
- Time: inject `Clock` (core:common) instead of `System.currentTimeMillis()` in logic.
---
paths:
  - "**/src/test/**"
  - "**/src/androidTest/**"
  - "core/testing/**"
  - "testdata/**"
---
# Testing rules
- Pyramid: many JVM unit tests (model, format, geometry, layout math) -> Robolectric + Roborazzi (UI, templates, rendering) -> few instrumented tests on the tablet (ink, real font metrics, IO, PDF) -> macrobenchmarks for budgets (P11).
- Names: `subject_condition_expectedResult`.
- Fakes over mocks (`core:testing`: FakeFolioFs, FakeClock, TestDispatchers, document builders). MockK only at framework edges.
- Flows with Turbine; assertions with Truth.
- Golden files in `testdata/` must stay small (< 1 MB each). Large fixtures are generated by test code.
- Record screenshot goldens only for intended changes; list them in the commit body ("goldens updated: ...").
- Instrumented tests run only via `bash scripts/device/instrumented.sh` against the debug package.
- Bug fix = failing test first. Randomized tests use fixed seeds printed on failure.
- Flaky test: fix it, or `@Ignore("FLAKY <id>")` + STATUS Deferred entry. Never add retry loops.

5	
6	/** One entry of a directory listing. Paths are relative to the FolioFs root, '/'-separated. */
7	data class FsEntry(
8	    val path: String,
9	    val isDirectory: Boolean,
10	    val sizeBytes: Long,
11	    val modifiedMs: Long,
12	)
13	
14	/**
15	 * File access below one root (the library folder or app files in the app, a temp dir in tests).
16	 * Paths are relative to the root and '/'-separated ("" is the root). Absolute paths, '\\' and ".."
17	 * segments are programmer errors and throw IllegalArgumentException in every method.
18	 * Calls block: run them on FolioDispatchers.io.
19	 */
20	interface FolioFs {
21	    /** True if a file or directory exists at [path]. */
22	    fun exists(path: String): Boolean
23	
24	    /** Size and modification time of [path], or null if it does not exist. */
25	    fun stat(path: String): FsEntry?
26	
27	    /** Direct children of [dir] ("" is the root). */
28	    fun list(dir: String): Outcome<List<FsEntry>>
29	
30	    /** Whole file content. */
31	    fun readBytes(path: String): Outcome<ByteArray>
32	
33	    /** Local file behind [path] for random-access readers (ZipFile), or null if not backed by java.io files. */
34	    fun localFile(path: String): java.io.File? = null
35	
36	    /** Stream over the file; the caller closes it. */
37	    fun openRead(path: String): Outcome<InputStream>
38	
39	    /**
40	     * Atomic write (file-format-storage rule): unique temp file in the same directory, [write] fills
41	     * it, flush + fsync, rename over [path], fsync the directory where supported. Readers never see a
42	     * partial file; the temp file is removed on failure (an exception thrown by [write] included).
43	     * Creates parent dirs.
44	     */
45	    fun writeAtomic(
46	        path: String,
47	        write: (OutputStream) -> Unit,
48	    ): Outcome<Unit>
49	
50	    /** [writeAtomic] with in-memory content. */
51	    fun writeBytesAtomic(
52	        path: String,
53	        bytes: ByteArray,
54	    ): Outcome<Unit> = writeAtomic(path) { it.write(bytes) }
55	
56	    /** Moves or renames; fails if [to] exists. Creates parent dirs of [to]. */
57	    fun move(
58	        from: String,
59	        to: String,
60	    ): Outcome<Unit>
61	
62	    /** Deletes a file or an empty directory. Deleting a missing path succeeds. */
63	    fun delete(path: String): Outcome<Unit>
64	
65	    /** Deletes a file or a directory with everything below it. Deleting a missing path succeeds. */
66	    fun deleteRecursively(path: String): Outcome<Unit>
67	
68	    /** Creates [dir] and its parents. */
69	    fun mkdirs(dir: String): Outcome<Unit>
70	}

15	 * library root; size + mtime detect external changes (#conflicts).
16	 */
17	@Serializable
18	data class BaseInfo(
19	    val docId: String,
20	    val sourcePath: String,
21	    val sourceSize: Long,
22	    val sourceMtimeMs: Long,
23	    val manifestModifiedMs: Long,
24	    val dirtyEntries: Set<String> = emptySet(),
25	    val lastPackMs: Long = 0L,

27	)

29	/**
30	 * Unpacked document in app-private `work/<docId>/` (same layout as the ZIP) plus `base.json`.
31	 * Blocking IO: call from the io dispatcher, one writer at a time (the session serializes access).
32	 */
33	class WorkingCopy internal constructor(
34	    private val appFs: FolioFs,
35	    val docId: DocId,
36	    base: BaseInfo,
37	) : EntryReader {
38	    /** Current `base.json` state. */
39	    var base: BaseInfo = base
40	        private set
41	
42	    /** Directory below the app files root. */
43	    val dir: String = dirOf(docId)
44	
45	    /** True while entries changed since the last pack. */
46	    val isDirty: Boolean get() = base.dirtyEntries.isNotEmpty()
47	
48	    override fun names(): Set<String> {
49	        val out = HashSet<String>()
50	        collect("", out)
51	        return out
52	    }
53	
54	    override fun read(
55	        name: String,
56	        maxBytes: Long,
57	    ): Outcome<ByteArray> {
58	        val stat = appFs.stat(path(name))
59	        return when {
60	            stat == null || stat.isDirectory -> Outcome.Failure("missing entry $name", FormatError.MissingEntry(name))
61	            stat.sizeBytes > maxBytes -> Outcome.Failure("entry $name too large", FormatError.Corrupt(name, "${stat.sizeBytes} bytes"))
62	            else -> appFs.readBytes(path(name))
63	        }
64	    }
65	
66	    /** Stream over entry [name]; the caller closes it. */
67	    fun open(name: String): Outcome<InputStream> = appFs.openRead(path(name))
68	
69	    /**
70	     * Writes changed entries atomically one by one (null = delete), then records them as dirty in
71	     * `base.json`. After a crash in between, the entry is on disk but maybe not marked: recovery also
72	     * packs copies whose entries are newer than the last pack.
73	     */
74	    fun writeEntries(changes: Map<String, ByteArray?>): Outcome<Unit> {
75	        for ((name, bytes) in changes) {
76	            require(name != BASE_JSON && !name.startsWith(".")) { "reserved entry name $name" }
77	            val result = if (bytes == null) appFs.delete(path(name)) else appFs.writeBytesAtomic(path(name), bytes)
78	            if (result is Outcome.Failure) return result
79	        }
80	        return updateBase(base.copy(dirtyEntries = base.dirtyEntries + changes.keys))
81	    }
82	
83	    /** Replaces and persists `base.json`. */
84	    fun updateBase(newBase: BaseInfo): Outcome<Unit> =
85	        appFs.writeBytesAtomic("$dir/$BASE_JSON", BaseJson.encodeToString(BaseInfo.serializer(), newBase).encodeToByteArray()).flatMap {
86	            base = newBase
87	            Outcome.Success(Unit)
88	        }
89	
90	    private fun path(name: String): String = "$dir/$name"
91	
92	    private fun collect(
93	        relative: String,
94	        out: MutableSet<String>,
95	    ) {
96	        val listing = appFs.list(if (relative.isEmpty()) dir else "$dir/$relative")
97	        val children = (listing as? Outcome.Success)?.value ?: return
98	        for (child in children) {
99	            val name = child.path.substringAfterLast('/')
100	            if (name.startsWith(".")) continue
101	            val rel = if (relative.isEmpty()) name else "$relative/$name"
102	            when {
103	                child.isDirectory -> collect(rel, out)
104	                rel != BASE_JSON -> out += rel
105	            }
106	        }
107	    }
108	
109	    /** Layout constants. */
110	    companion object {
111	        /** Name of the state file inside the working copy directory. */
112	        const val BASE_JSON = "base.json"
113	
114	        /** Parent of all working copies (app files). */
115	        const val WORK_DIR = "work"
116	
117	        /** Working copy directory of [docId]. */
118	        fun dirOf(docId: DocId): String = "$WORK_DIR/${docId.value}"
119	    }
120	}
121	
122	internal val BaseJson =
123	    Json {
124	        ignoreUnknownKeys = true
125	        encodeDefaults = true
126	    }

22	    private val libraryFs: FolioFs,

24	    /**
25	     * Working copy for the `.folio` at [sourcePath]. Reuses an existing copy of the same document if it
26	     * was made from this file and the file did not change since (size + mtime), or if it has unsaved
27	     * changes (the packer resolves those as a conflict). Otherwise unpacks the file fresh.

29	    fun open(sourcePath: String): Outcome<WorkingCopy> {
30	        val stat = libraryFs.stat(sourcePath) ?: return Outcome.Failure("source $sourcePath does not exist")
31	        return peekDocId(sourcePath).flatMap { docId ->
32	            val existing = find(docId)
33	            val unchanged =
34	                existing != null &&
35	                    existing.base.sourcePath == sourcePath &&
36	                    existing.base.sourceSize == stat.sizeBytes &&
37	                    existing.base.sourceMtimeMs == stat.modifiedMs
38	            if (existing != null && (unchanged || existing.isDirty)) {

49	        val base = runCatching { BaseJson.decodeFromString(BaseInfo.serializer(), bytes.decodeToString()) }.getOrNull() ?: return null

71	                        generateSequence { zip.nextEntry }.firstOrNull { it.name == FolioEntries.MANIFEST }

80	        docId: DocId,

88	                .flatMap { input -> extract(input, staging) }
89	                .flatMap {

91	                }.flatMap {
92	                    appFs.move(staging, WorkingCopy.dirOf(docId))
93	                }.flatMap {

96	                        copy.updateBase(copy.base.copy(manifestModifiedMs = manifest.modifiedMs)).map { copy }

98	                }

101	    }
102	
103	    private fun extract(
104	        input: InputStream,
105	        staging: String,
106	    ): Outcome<Unit> =
107	        outcomeOf("unpack into $staging") {
108	            var total = 0L
109	            ZipInputStream(input).use { zip ->
110	                for (entry in generateSequence { zip.nextEntry }) {
111	                    if (entry.isDirectory || !FolioEntries.isValidName(entry.name)) continue
112	                    val result =

114	                            total += copyLimited(zip, out, MAX_UNPACKED_BYTES - total)
115	                        }

127	internal fun readLimited(
128	    input: InputStream,
129	    maxBytes: Long,
130	): ByteArray {
131	    val out = java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream()
132	    copyLimited(input, out, maxBytes)
133	    return out.toByteArray()
134	}

136	internal fun copyLimited(
137	    input: InputStream,
138	    out: java.io.OutputStream,
139	    maxBytes: Long,
140	): Long {
141	    val buffer = ByteArray(COPY_BUFFER_BYTES)
142	    var copied = 0L
143	    while (true) {
144	        val n = input.read(buffer)
145	        if (n < 0) return copied
146	        copied += n
147	        if (copied > maxBytes) throw IOException("entry exceeds $maxBytes bytes")
148	        out.write(buffer, 0, n)
149	    }
150	}

## Where does a fact go? (first match wins)
1. Needed in every session, short, stable -> CLAUDE.md `## Learned` (one line, dated, task id).

## Triggers to record something
- The same error, correction, or workaround happened twice.
- A tooling or build quirk (Windows vs Arch differences included).
- A device or HyperOS behavior.
- A library API gotcha or version constraint.
- A decision the user made in chat.

15	/** Something start-up recovery did that the UI reports once (04-file-format.md#crash-recovery). */
16	sealed interface RecoveryEvent {
17	    /** Id of the affected document. */
18	    val docId: DocId
19	
20	    /** Unsaved changes were packed into the document. */
21	    data class Recovered(
22	        override val docId: DocId,
23	        val path: String,
24	    ) : RecoveryEvent
25	
26	    /** The document changed externally meanwhile: the changes went to a conflict copy. */
27	    data class Conflict(
28	        override val docId: DocId,
29	        val path: String,
30	    ) : RecoveryEvent
31	
32	    /** The document no longer exists; its working copy is kept (7 days) and offered as "Recovered: <title>". */
33	    data class Orphaned(
34	        override val docId: DocId,
35	        val title: String,
36	    ) : RecoveryEvent
37	}
38	
39	/** Pending recovery events for the UI; the UI consumes each after showing it. */
40	class RecoveryEvents {
41	    private val state = MutableStateFlow<List<RecoveryEvent>>(emptyList())
42	
43	    /** Events not yet shown. */
44	    val pending: StateFlow<List<RecoveryEvent>> = state.asStateFlow()
45	
46	    /** Adds events. */
47	    fun publish(events: List<RecoveryEvent>) = state.update { it + events }
48	
49	    /** Marks [event] as shown. */
50	    fun consume(event: RecoveryEvent) = state.update { it - event }
51	}
52	
53	/** Start-up recovery: packs dirty working copies, reports conflicts and orphans, drops old orphans. */
54	class Recovery(
55	    private val store: WorkingCopyStore,
56	    private val packer: Packer,
57	    private val clock: Clock,
58	    private val events: RecoveryEvents,
59	) {
60	    private val done = AtomicBoolean(false)
61	
62	    /** [run] on the first call of the process only (the library entry calls it once access is granted). */
63	    fun runOnce(): List<RecoveryEvent> = if (done.compareAndSet(false, true)) run() else emptyList()
64	
65	    /** Packs dirty working copies; call before any document opens. Blocking: io dispatcher. */
66	    fun run(): List<RecoveryEvent> {
67	        val out = ArrayList<RecoveryEvent>()
68	        for (copy in store.all()) {
69	            if (!copy.isDirty) continue
70	            when (val r = packer.pack(copy)) {
71	                is Outcome.Failure -> FolioLog.w(TAG, "recovery pack of ${copy.docId.value} failed: ${r.message}", r.cause)
72	                is Outcome.Success -> handle(copy, r.value)?.let(out::add)
73	            }
74	        }
75	        events.publish(out)
76	        return out
77	    }
78	
79	    private fun handle(
80	        copy: WorkingCopy,
81	        result: PackResult,
82	    ): RecoveryEvent? =
83	        when (result) {
84	            is PackResult.Packed -> RecoveryEvent.Recovered(copy.docId, result.path)
85	            is PackResult.ConflictCopy -> RecoveryEvent.Conflict(copy.docId, result.path)
86	            PackResult.Clean -> null
87	            PackResult.SourceMissing -> orphan(copy)
88	        }
89	
90	    private fun orphan(copy: WorkingCopy): RecoveryEvent? {
91	        val lastActivityMs = maxOf(copy.base.lastPackMs, copy.base.manifestModifiedMs)
92	        if (clock.nowMs() - lastActivityMs > ORPHAN_KEEP_MS) {
93	            store.discard(copy.docId)
94	            return null
95	        }
96	        val title =
97	            DocumentCodec
98	                .readManifest(copy)
99	                .getOrNull()
100	                ?.title
101	                .orEmpty()
102	        return RecoveryEvent.Orphaned(copy.docId, title)
103	    }
104	
105	    private companion object {
106	        const val TAG = "Recovery"
107	        const val ORPHAN_KEEP_MS = 7L * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000
108	    }
109	}

13	
14	/**
15	 * Debounced entry autosave (04-file-format.md#write-protocol step 2): changed entries are written
16	 * after [debounceMs] without further changes. Providers are evaluated at write time so a burst of
17	 * edits encodes each entry once. A provider returning null deletes the entry.
18	 */
19	class EntryAutosaver(
20	    private val scope: CoroutineScope,
21	    private val io: CoroutineDispatcher,
22	    private val debounceMs: Long = DEFAULT_DEBOUNCE_MS,
23	    private val write: (Map<String, ByteArray?>) -> Outcome<Unit>,
24	) {
25	    private val lock = Mutex()
26	    private val pending = LinkedHashMap<String, () -> ByteArray?>()
27	    private var timer: Job? = null
28	
29	    /** Marks [name] changed; restarts the idle timer. */
30	    fun schedule(
31	        name: String,
32	        provider: () -> ByteArray?,
33	    ) {
34	        synchronized(pending) { pending[name] = provider }
35	        timer?.cancel()
36	        timer =
37	            scope.launch {
38	                delay(debounceMs)
39	                flush()
40	            }
41	    }
42	
43	    /** Writes everything pending now (before pack, close, onStop). Returns the write result. */
44	    suspend fun flush(): Outcome<Unit> =
45	        lock.withLock {
46	            val batch = synchronized(pending) { LinkedHashMap(pending).also { pending.clear() } }
47	            if (batch.isEmpty()) return@withLock Outcome.Success(Unit)
48	            val result = withContext(io) { write(batch.mapValues { (_, provider) -> provider() }) }
49	            if (result is Outcome.Failure) {
50	                FolioLog.w(TAG, "autosave failed: ${result.message}", result.cause)
51	                // Keep the entries so the next flush retries them (newer providers win).
52	                synchronized(pending) { batch.forEach { (k, v) -> pending.putIfAbsent(k, v) } }
53	            }
54	            result
55	        }
56	
57	    /** True while changes wait for the timer. */
58	    val hasPending: Boolean get() = synchronized(pending) { pending.isNotEmpty() }
59	
60	    /** Defaults. */
61	    companion object {
62	        /** Idle time before entries are written. */
63	        const val DEFAULT_DEBOUNCE_MS = 1000L
64	        private const val TAG = "Autosave"
65	    }
66	}

189	        autosaver.schedule(FolioEntries.SEARCH_TEXT) { DocumentEntries.searchText(state.value).encodeToByteArray() }
190	        state.value = evict(after, protect = touched + changedPages)
191	        if (changedPages.isNotEmpty()) thumbnails.pagesChanged(state.value, changedPages)
192	        startPackTimer()
193	    }
194	
195	    private fun scheduleFlows(
196	        before: Document,
197	        after: Document,
198	    ) {
199	        val changed = after.flows.filter { (id, flow) -> before.flows[id] !== flow }.keys
200	        val removed = before.flows.keys - after.flows.keys
201	        for (id in changed + removed) {
202	            autosaver.schedule(FolioEntries.flowText(id)) { flowEntry(id, 0) }
203	            autosaver.schedule(FolioEntries.flowStyle(id)) { flowEntry(id, 1) }
204	        }
205	    }
206	
207	    private fun flowEntry(
208	        id: FlowId,
209	        index: Int,
210	    ): ByteArray? = state.value.flows[id]?.let { DocumentEntries.encodeFlow(it)[index].second }
211	
212	    private fun pageBytes(id: PageId): ByteArray? {
213	        val doc = state.value
214	        val body = doc.pageBodies[id] ?: return if (doc.pageRef(id) == null) null else unchangedPage(id)
215	        return PageCodec.encode(body)
216	    }
217	
218	    // A pinned page is never evicted; this only covers a page that was removed and restored meanwhile.
219	    private fun unchangedPage(id: PageId): ByteArray? =
220	        (copy.read(FolioEntries.page(id), FolioEntries.MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES) as? Outcome.Success)?.value
221	
222	    private fun manifestBytes(): ByteArray {
223	        val doc = state.value
224	        return DocumentEntries.encodeManifest(doc.copy(meta = doc.meta.copy(modifiedMs = lastEditMs)), app)
225	    }
226	
227	    private fun writeEntries(entries: Map<String, ByteArray?>): Outcome<Unit> {
228	        val result = synchronized(copyLock) { copy.writeEntries(entries) }
229	        if (result is Outcome.Success) {
230	            val written = entries.keys.filter { it.startsWith("pages/") }.map { PageId(it.removePrefix("pages/").removeSuffix(".pb")) }
231	            synchronized(pinned) { pinned.removeAll(written.toSet()) }
232	        }
233	        return result
234	    }
235	
236	    private fun evict(
237	        doc: Document,
238	        protect: Set<PageId>,
239	    ): Document {
240	        if (doc.pageBodies.size <= maxDecodedPages) return doc
241	        val bodies = doc.pageBodies.builder()
242	        val keep = synchronized(pinned) { pinned + protect }
243	        val iterator = lru.keys.iterator()
244	        while (bodies.size > maxDecodedPages && iterator.hasNext()) {
245	            val id = iterator.next()
246	            if (id in keep) continue
247	            bodies.remove(id)
248	            iterator.remove()
249	        }
250	        // Bodies loaded without LRU tracking (initial document) go first.
251	        bodies.keys.filter { it !in lru && it !in keep }.forEach { if (bodies.size > maxDecodedPages) bodies.remove(it) }
252	        return doc.copy(pageBodies = bodies.build())
253	    }
254	
255	    private fun startPackTimer() {
256	        if (packTimer?.isActive == true) return
257	        packTimer =
258	            scope.launch {
259	                delay(packIntervalMs)
260	                val r = pack()
261	                if (r is Outcome.Failure) FolioLog.w(TAG, "timed pack failed: ${r.message}", r.cause)
262	            }
263	    }
264	
265	    /** Defaults from 03-document-model.md#sessions and 04-file-format.md#write-protocol. */
266	    companion object {
267	        /** Decoded pages kept in memory. */
268	        const val DEFAULT_MAX_DECODED_PAGES = 30
269	
270	        /** Pack interval while dirty. */
271	        const val DEFAULT_PACK_INTERVAL_MS = 30_000L
272	        private const val TAG = "DocumentSession"
273	        private const val INITIAL_LRU = 64
274	        private const val LOAD_FACTOR = 0.75f
275	    }
276	}

# Gotchas
Longer explanations moved out of CLAUDE.md `## Learned` or rules. One section per topic, newest last. Keep < 200 lines.

## connectedAndroidTest can report BUILD SUCCESSFUL without running tests
When the APK install fails (e.g. HyperOS `INSTALL_FAILED_USER_RESTRICTED`), `connectedDebugAndroidTest` still ends with BUILD SUCCESSFUL. Judge instrumented runs by `<module>/build/outputs/androidTest-results/connected/**/TEST-*.xml` (test count > 0, no failures), never by the Gradle status alone.

## Robolectric on JDK 21 needs module flags
Robolectric (SDK 36 sandbox) reflects into `java.io.FileDescriptor` via `jdk.internal.access`; without `--add-opens java.base/java.io` and `--add-exports java.base/jdk.internal.access` it fails with "Failed to interact with raw FileDescriptor internals". `folio.screenshot` sets both.

## Robolectric SDK pin per module
Robolectric 4.17 supports up to SDK 36 while targetSdk is 37. Every module that applies `folio.screenshot` needs `src/test/resources/robolectric.properties` with `sdk=36` (see :app) until Robolectric supports 37.

## APK size comparisons need clean builds
Incremental debug packaging keeps entries of removed dependencies: switching a library to `compileOnly` changed the debug APK by only kilobytes. Compare sizes only after `./gradlew :app:clean :app:assembleDebug` (P01-S4: RaTeX +3.54 MB arm64 measured this way).

## AGP 9: extra source directories via the variant API
`android.sourceSets.getByName("androidTest").assets.srcDir(...)` fails in AGP 9 with a ClassCastException (old `AndroidLibrarySourceSet` type). Use `androidComponents { onVariants { it.androidTest?.sources?.assets?.addStaticSourceDirectory(path) } }` (used for the math corpus in commit b8f3c31, removed with the probe in P01-T08).

## Host has no unzip
Neither `unzip` nor `python` may be used here; inspect AAR/JAR sources on GitHub (raw.githubusercontent.com) or let Gradle resolve the artifact instead.

# Folio

Native Android hybrid note app (pen ink + grid-snapped Markdown text) for one device: Xiaomi Pad 7 (HyperOS, 3200x2136, 144 Hz, Xiaomi Focus Pen, Bluetooth keyboard). Personal, offline, sideloaded, English UI. The user steers and tests; you design details, build, verify.

<!-- Maintainers: this file is capped at 200 lines by .claude/hooks/guard-memory-size.sh. HTML comments are stripped from context. -->

## Hard constraints (never violate)
- Offline: no INTERNET or network-state permission in any merged manifest (`./gradlew verifyNoInternet`). No network code, analytics, or crash-reporting SDKs.
- Tablet access only via `bash scripts/device/*.sh`. Raw `adb`/`fastboot` is blocked by hook.
- Only `dev.folio.notes.debug` (and later `dev.folio.notes.benchmark`) may be installed, launched, cleared, or tested. Only `/sdcard/Documents/Folio-Debug/` may be written.
- Never touch the release package `dev.folio.notes` or `Documents/Folio/` on the device.
- Pen input never triggers Compose recomposition per motion event. Wet ink = androidx.ink InProgressStrokesView inside the canvas host view.
- `.folio` files in the library folder are the source of truth. The Room index is a disposable cache.
- Grid invariant: every text line's baseline sits on a template grid line; every text line box is an integer multiple of the grid unit U. Fonts, inline LaTeX, tables, headings must not break it.
- Protected (hook-enforced): `.claude/settings.json`, `.claude/hooks/**`, `scripts/device/**`. Propose changes as a Blocked item with the exact diff.
- Never accept licenses, terms, or pairing prompts on the user's behalf.

## Session protocol
1. The STATUS.md snapshot is injected at session start. If missing, read `docs/plan/STATUS.md`.
2. All plan work uses the `next-task` skill. One task = one commit (large tasks: sub-commits `PNN-TNNa`, `b`).
3. Read only the current phase file (Grep `^### <task-id>`, then Read that block) and the anchors in the task's `Read:` line.
4. Done = every `Accept:` item verified by a command you ran in this session.
5. `device:` checks run through the `device-tester` subagent. `user:` checks go to STATUS `USER-CHECK` (non-blocking).
6. Needs the human to proceed → STATUS `Blocked`, then continue with the next unblocked task.
7. Spec deviation → `docs/plan/AMENDMENTS.md` entry + doc update in the same commit. Never deviate silently.
8. Phase end → REVIEW step (reviewer subagent, fixes, full `./gradlew qa`, tag `pNN-done`).
9. Interactive sessions: after an auto-compaction or 3 completed tasks, finish the current task, write the STATUS Handoff, stop. Fresh sessions beat long ones.

## Commands
| Purpose | Command |
|---|---|
| Environment check | `bash scripts/env/doctor.sh` |
| Build debug APK | `./gradlew :app:assembleDebug` |
| All checks | `./gradlew qa` (spotless, detekt, lint, unit + screenshot tests, verifyNoInternet) |
| Module tests | `./gradlew :core:text:testDebugUnitTest` (JVM modules: `./gradlew :core:model:test`) |
| Screenshot goldens | `./gradlew verifyRoborazziDebug` / `./gradlew recordRoborazziDebug` |
| Format | `./gradlew spotlessApply` |
| Device connect / facts | `bash scripts/device/connect.sh` / `bash scripts/device/info.sh` |
| Install + launch | `bash scripts/device/install.sh && bash scripts/device/launch.sh [--doc f] [--route r]` |
| Debug command | `bash scripts/device/debugcmd.sh <cmd> [arg]` (reply read from logcat tag FolioDebug) |
| Instrumented tests | `bash scripts/device/instrumented.sh :module [connectedDebugAndroidTest]` |
| Screenshot | `bash scripts/device/screenshot.sh <name>` -> `.device/screens/<name>.png` |
| Logs / frames / diag | `logcat.sh [n]`, `gfxinfo.sh [reset]`, `diag.sh layers`, `refresh`, `meminfo` (all in scripts/device) |
| Unattended loop | `bash scripts/auto/run-loop.sh <maxTasks>` (the user starts it, never you) |

## Module map (details: docs/architecture/02-modules.md)
| Module | Owns |
|---|---|
| `app` | Application, MainActivity, navigation, DI graph, debug automation (debug source set) |
| `core:common` | dispatchers, Outcome, logging, PerfMonitor, FolioFs interface |
| `core:model` | JVM. Document, pages, objects, geometry, spatial index, commands, undo |
| `core:format` | JVM. `.folio` container, Wire protobuf, manifest JSON, migrations |
| `core:storage` | library folder, working copies, packer, Room index + FTS, trash, DataStore settings |
| `core:ink` | androidx.ink bridge: brushes, input routing, eraser, lasso, shape recognizer, stylus caps |
| `core:text` | markdown blocks, fonts, grid line-box layout, flows, math renderer |
| `core:render` | viewport, templates, tile caches, PageRenderer (screen, PNG, PDF) |
| `core:pdf` | PDF import, background rasterizer, export pipeline |
| `core:designsystem` | tokens, theme, fonts (UI), icons, shared components |
| `core:testing` | fakes, fixtures, rules |
| `feature:library` | home, folders, tags, search, bin |
| `feature:editor` | editor panes, canvas host, toolbar, tools, split view |
| `feature:settings` | settings screens |
| `tools:icongen` | JVM tool: Lucide SVG -> Compose ImageVector source |

## Where knowledge lives
| Need | Location |
|---|---|
| What next | `docs/plan/STATUS.md` -> current `docs/plan/phase-NN-*.md` |
| Requirements (R-IDs) | `docs/architecture/01-requirements.md` |
| Design (how) | `docs/architecture/NN-*.md`; decisions in `decisions.md` |
| Device facts | `docs/notes/device.md` |
| Toolchain, dependency list | `docs/notes/env.md`, `gradle/libs.versions.toml` |
| Performance numbers | `docs/notes/perf.md` (budgets: `12-performance.md`) |
| Longer gotchas | `docs/notes/gotchas.md` |
| Coding rules | `.claude/rules/*.md` (load automatically by path) |
| Visual direction | `docs/design/reference/*.png` + `11-design-system.md` |

## Definition of done (every task)
- All `Accept:` items verified; touched modules pass spotless, detekt, lint, unit tests. Full `./gradlew qa` at phase end.
- New logic has unit tests. New UI state has a Roborazzi screenshot test. Every bug fix starts with a failing test.
- No suppressed warning without a one-line reason. No TODO without an id listed under STATUS `Deferred`.
- Commit message: `<type>(<scope>): <summary> [PNN-TNN]`; body lists verification commands and results, updated goldens, amendments.
- STATUS.md updated in the same commit.

## Engineering defaults
- Kotlin, Jetpack Compose UI, Hilt, coroutines + Flow, Room, DataStore, Wire, kotlinx.serialization. Versions only in `gradle/libs.versions.toml`.
- Page space is PDF points (1/72 inch). Convert via Viewport helpers only. Name units: `xPt`, `sizePx`, `durationMs`.
- Hot paths (input, rendering, layout, typing): no per-event allocation, no logging, no Flow emission per point. Trace with PerfMonitor sections.
- Prefer boring, testable code. Pure logic in JVM modules. Android specifics behind small interfaces.
- Keep tool output small: Gradle with `--quiet --console=plain`, re-run only the failing task, pipe long output through `tail -n 80`. Never cat build logs or large files whole.

## Memory upkeep (hook-enforced limits)
- This file <= 200 lines. Each rule file <= 120 lines. STATUS.md <= 60 lines. Skill files <= 200 lines.
- `## Learned` holds at most 20 one-line entries, newest last. Add one when the same problem appears twice or a non-obvious fact would save a future session time. When full, or when an entry only matters for some paths, follow the `maintain-memory` skill.
- Auto memory is disabled for this project (`autoMemoryEnabled: false`) because work happens on two machines; everything worth keeping lives in the repository.

## Learned
<!-- Format: - YYYY-MM-DD <fact> (<task id>) -->
- 2026-09-27 SDK packages are installed by the USER (`cmdline-tools/latest/bin/android sdk install platforms/android-NN`); with cmdline-tools 23 installing is the license acceptance, see docs/notes/env.md (P00-T01)

24	/** Container entries -> Document. Works on any [EntryReader] (ZIP file or working copy). Writing: [DocumentEntries]. */
25	object DocumentCodec {
26	    /** Parses and version-checks `manifest.json` (unknown keys ignored, migrations applied). */
27	    fun readManifest(
28	        reader: EntryReader,
29	        migrations: MigrationRegistry = MigrationRegistry.DEFAULT,
30	    ): Outcome<Manifest> =
31	        reader.read(FolioEntries.MANIFEST, FolioEntries.MAX_MANIFEST_BYTES).flatMap { bytes ->
32	            parseManifest(bytes.decodeToString(), migrations)
33	        }
34	
35	    /** Parses manifest text (see [readManifest]). */
36	    fun parseManifest(
37	        text: String,
38	        migrations: MigrationRegistry = MigrationRegistry.DEFAULT,
39	    ): Outcome<Manifest> =
40	        guard(FolioEntries.MANIFEST) {
41	            val raw = FolioJson.parseToJsonElement(text).jsonObject
42	            val version = raw["formatVersion"]?.jsonPrimitive?.int ?: throw CorruptDataException("formatVersion missing")
43	            migrations.plan(version).map { plan ->
44	                var json: JsonObject = raw
45	                plan.forEach { json = it.migrateManifest(json) }
46	                FolioJson.decodeFromJsonElement(Manifest.serializer(), json)
47	            }
48	        }
49	
50	    /** Document with meta, page refs, flows and assets; page bodies only if [loadPages]. */
51	    fun readDocument(
52	        reader: EntryReader,
53	        loadPages: Boolean = false,
54	        migrations: MigrationRegistry = MigrationRegistry.DEFAULT,
55	    ): Outcome<Document> =
56	        readManifest(reader, migrations).flatMap { manifest ->
57	            guard(FolioEntries.MANIFEST) { Outcome.Success(ManifestMapper.toDocumentShell(manifest)) }.flatMap { shell ->
58	                readFlows(reader, manifest.flows.map(::FlowId)).flatMap { flows ->
59	                    val doc = shell.copy(flows = flows.associateBy { it.id }.toPersistentMap())
60	                    if (loadPages) readAllPages(reader, doc) else Outcome.Success(doc)
61	                }
62	            }
63	        }
64	
65	    /** Decodes one page body. */
66	    fun readPage(
67	        reader: EntryReader,
68	        id: PageId,
69	    ): Outcome<Page> {
70	        val name = FolioEntries.page(id)
71	        return reader.read(name, FolioEntries.MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES).flatMap { bytes ->
72	            PageCodec.decode(bytes, name).flatMap { page ->
73	                if (page.id == id) Outcome.Success(page) else corrupt(name, "page id ${page.id.value} does not match its entry")
74	            }
75	        }
76	    }
77	
78	    /** Reads flow Markdown + style. A missing style file falls back to defaults. */
79	    fun readFlow(
80	        reader: EntryReader,
81	        id: FlowId,
82	    ): Outcome<TextFlow> =
83	        reader.read(FolioEntries.flowText(id), FolioEntries.MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES).flatMap { md ->
84	            val styleName = FolioEntries.flowStyle(id)
85	            val styleJson =
86	                if (styleName in reader.names()) {
87	                    reader.read(styleName, FolioEntries.MAX_MANIFEST_BYTES).flatMap { bytes ->
88	                        guard(styleName) { Outcome.Success(FolioJson.decodeFromString(FlowStyleJson.serializer(), bytes.decodeToString())) }
89	                    }
90	                } else {
91	                    Outcome.Success(FlowStyleJson())
92	                }
93	            styleJson.map { s -> TextFlow(id, md.decodeToString(), ManifestMapper.flowStyleFromJson(s), s.autoContinue) }
94	        }
95	
96	    private fun readFlows(
97	        reader: EntryReader,
98	        ids: List<FlowId>,
99	    ): Outcome<List<TextFlow>> {
100	        val flows = ArrayList<TextFlow>(ids.size)
101	        for (id in ids) {
102	            when (val r = readFlow(reader, id)) {
103	                is Outcome.Success -> flows += r.value
104	                is Outcome.Failure -> return r
105	            }
106	        }
107	        return Outcome.Success(flows)
108	    }
109	
110	    private fun readAllPages(
111	        reader: EntryReader,
112	        doc: Document,
113	    ): Outcome<Document> {
114	        val bodies = doc.pageBodies.builder()
115	        for (ref in doc.pages) {
116	            when (val r = readPage(reader, ref.id)) {
117	                is Outcome.Success -> bodies[ref.id] = r.value
118	                is Outcome.Failure -> return r
119	            }
120	        }
121	        return Outcome.Success(doc.copy(pageBodies = bodies.build()))
122	    }
123	
124	    // SerializationException and NumberFormatException are IllegalArgumentExceptions.
125	    private inline fun <T> guard(
126	        entry: String,
127	        block: () -> Outcome<T>,
128	    ): Outcome<T> =
129	        try {
130	            block()
131	        } catch (e: IllegalArgumentException) {
132	            corrupt(entry, e.message.orEmpty(), e)
133	        } catch (e: CorruptDataException) {
134	            corrupt(entry, e.message.orEmpty(), e)
135	        }
136	}

6	/** Entry names and layout rules of the `.folio` ZIP (04-file-format.md#container-layout). */
7	object FolioEntries {
8	    /** First entry, STORED. */
9	    const val MIMETYPE = "mimetype"
10	
11	    /** Content of [MIMETYPE]. */
12	    const val MIME_TYPE_VALUE = "application/vnd.folio+zip"
13	
14	    /** Document metadata. */
15	    const val MANIFEST = "manifest.json"
16	
17	    /** Plain text for the search index. */
18	    const val SEARCH_TEXT = "search/text.txt"
19	
20	    /** Library cover thumbnail. */
21	    const val COVER = "thumbs/cover.webp"
22	
23	    /** Largest manifest accepted (untrusted input bound). */
24	    const val MAX_MANIFEST_BYTES = 4L * 1024 * 1024
25	
26	    /** Largest page or flow entry accepted. */
27	    const val MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES = 64L * 1024 * 1024
28	
29	    private const val MAX_NAME_LENGTH = 255
30	    private const val ASCII_MAX = 0x7F
31	    private const val PRINTABLE_MIN = 0x20
32	
33	    /** Page body entry. */
34	    fun page(id: PageId): String = "pages/${id.value}.pb"
35	
36	    /** Flow Markdown entry. */
37	    fun flowText(id: FlowId): String = "flows/${id.value}.md"
38	
39	    /** Flow style entry. */
40	    fun flowStyle(id: FlowId): String = "flows/${id.value}.json"
41	
42	    /** Page thumbnail entry. */
43	    fun pageThumb(id: PageId): String = "thumbs/${id.value}.webp"
44	
45	    /** Safe relative entry name: printable ASCII, no absolute path, no backslash, no `.`/`..` segments. */
46	    fun isValidName(name: String): Boolean =
47	        name.isNotEmpty() &&
48	            name.length <= MAX_NAME_LENGTH &&
49	            name.all { it.code in PRINTABLE_MIN..ASCII_MAX && it != '\\' } &&
50	            !name.startsWith("/") &&
51	            !name.endsWith("/") &&
52	            name.split('/').none { it.isEmpty() || it == "." || it == ".." }
53	
54	    /** Assets and thumbnails are already compressed: STORED. Everything else DEFLATED level 6. */
55	    fun isStored(name: String): Boolean = name == MIMETYPE || name.startsWith("assets/") || name.startsWith("thumbs/")
56	
57	    /** Names in container order: mimetype, manifest, pages, flows, assets, thumbs, search, then unknown entries. */
58	    fun ordered(names: Collection<String>): List<String> = names.sortedWith(compareBy<String>({ rank(it) }, { it }))
59	
60	    // Container layout order; unknown entries (preserved from newer writers) go last.
61	    private val ORDER: List<(String) -> Boolean> =
62	        listOf(
63	            { it == MIMETYPE },
64	            { it == MANIFEST },
65	            { it.startsWith("pages/") },
66	            { it.startsWith("flows/") },
67	            { it.startsWith("assets/") },
68	            { it.startsWith("thumbs/") },
69	            { it == SEARCH_TEXT },
70	        )
71	
72	    private fun rank(name: String): Int = ORDER.indexOfFirst { it(name) }.let { if (it < 0) ORDER.size else it }
73	}

1	# 03 Document model
2	Pure Kotlin in `core:model` (JVM module). Immutable data; persistent collections from kotlinx.collections.immutable.
3	
4	## Ids and units
5	- Ids: `DocId`, `PageId`, `ObjectId`, `FlowId`, `AssetId` are value classes over strings. Doc/page/object/flow ids are UUIDv4 (lowercase, no braces); `AssetId` is the lowercase hex SHA-256 of the asset bytes.
6	- Page space unit: PDF point (1 pt = 1/72 inch = 0.352778 mm). Origin top-left of the page, y down. Infinite pages allow negative coordinates.
7	- Colors: ARGB `Int` (`0xAARRGGBB`), sRGB.
8	- Angles: degrees. Time: epoch ms for metadata, stroke timing relative per stroke.
9	- Screen units (px, dp) never appear in core:model.
10	
11	## Geometry
12	- `PointPt(x: Float, y: Float)`, `RectPt(left, top, right, bottom)` with `union`, `intersects`, `contains`, `inset`, `isEmpty`.
13	- `Affine(a, b, c, d, tx, ty)` with `compose`, `invert`, `mapPoint`, `mapRect` (axis-aligned bounds of the mapped rect).
14	- `polygonContains(points, p)` (even-odd), `segmentDistance(p, a, b)`, `polylineLength`.
15	- `UniformGridIndex<T>` per page: cell 128 pt; `insert(id, bounds)`, `remove(id)`, `update(id, bounds)`, `query(rect)`, `queryRadius(point, r)`. Used for hit testing, lasso candidates, and tile invalidation.
16	
17	## Document
18	```kotlin
19	data class Document(
20	  val meta: DocumentMeta,
21	  val pages: PersistentList<PageRef>,          // order = page order; Page bodies load lazily
22	  val flows: PersistentMap<FlowId, TextFlow>,
23	  val assets: PersistentMap<AssetId, AssetInfo>,
24	  val pageBodies: PersistentMap<PageId, Page>,  // decoded bodies the session holds (A-009)
25	)
26	data class DocumentMeta(
27	  val id: DocId, val title: String, val createdMs: Long, val modifiedMs: Long,
28	  val tags: PersistentSet<String>, val favorite: Boolean, val formatVersion: Int,
29	  val defaultPageSpec: PageSpec, val defaultBackground: Background,
30	)
31	data class AssetInfo(val id: AssetId, val mime: String, val bytes: Long, val originalName: String?)
32	```
33	`PageRef(id, spec, background, contentBounds?)` = lightweight summary so the page stack can lay out all pages without decoding objects. `Page` is decoded on demand by the session and kept in `pageBodies`; a page without a body is unchanged since its last write. Commands that touch objects require the body to be loaded; for a loaded page, body spec/background equal the `PageRef` (A-009).
34	
35	## Pages
36	```kotlin
37	enum class PaperSize(val widthPt: Float, val heightPt: Float) {
38	  A3(841.8898f, 1190.5512f), A4(595.2756f, 841.8898f), A5(419.5276f, 595.2756f)
39	}
40	enum class Orientation { PORTRAIT, LANDSCAPE }             // landscape swaps width/height
41	sealed interface PageSpec {
42	  data class Fixed(val size: PaperSize, val orientation: Orientation) : PageSpec
43	  data class Custom(val widthPt: Float, val heightPt: Float) : PageSpec   // PDF pages with other sizes
44	  data class Infinite(val origin: PageSpec) : PageSpec     // origin is Fixed or Custom; keeps the template frame
45	}
46	data class Background(val paperArgb: Int, val template: Template, val pdf: PdfBackground?)
47	data class Template(val kind: TemplateKind, val spacingPt: Float, val lineArgb: Int,
48	                    val marginLeftPt: Float, val marginTopPt: Float,
49	                    val customAsset: AssetId?, val customGridPt: Float?)
50	data class PdfBackground(val asset: AssetId, val pageIndex: Int)  // page spec = PDF page size (A-size match or Custom)
51	data class Page(val id: PageId, val spec: PageSpec, val background: Background,
52	                val objects: PersistentList<PageObject>)          // index 0 = bottom of z-order
53	```
54	PDF pages whose size matches A3/A4/A5 within 1 pt use `Fixed`, all others `Custom`. Template kinds: see 05-canvas-rendering.md#templates.
55	Content bounds of infinite pages = union of object bounds, cached in the page summary.
56	
57	## Objects
58	```kotlin
59	sealed interface PageObject { val id: ObjectId; val bounds: RectPt }
60	data class InkStroke(override val id: ObjectId, val brush: BrushSpec, val inputs: StrokeInputs,
61	                     override val bounds: RectPt) : PageObject
62	data class BrushSpec(val kind: BrushKind, val argb: Int, val sizePt: Float, val version: Int,
63	                     val pressureGamma: Float = 1f)
64	enum class BrushKind { BALLPOINT, FOUNTAIN, PENCIL, MARKER, HIGHLIGHTER }
65	class StrokeInputs(               // struct-of-arrays, immutable after creation
66	  val x: FloatArray, val y: FloatArray, val tMs: FloatArray,
67	  val pressure: FloatArray?, val tiltDeg: FloatArray?, val orientationDeg: FloatArray?,
68	  val tool: InputTool)            // STYLUS, ERASER_END, SYNTHETIC
69	data class Shape(override val id: ObjectId, val kind: ShapeKind, val points: List<PointPt>,
70	                 val rotationDeg: Float, val stroke: StrokeStyle, val fillArgb: Int?,
71	                 override val bounds: RectPt) : PageObject
72	enum class ShapeKind { LINE, ARROW, RECTANGLE, ELLIPSE, TRIANGLE, POLYGON }
73	data class StrokeStyle(val argb: Int, val widthPt: Float, val dashed: Boolean)
74	data class FlowFrame(override val id: ObjectId, val flow: FlowId, val rect: RectPt, val order: Int,
75	                     val role: FrameRole, val autoGrow: Boolean) : PageObject   // BODY, BOX
76	data class ImageObject(override val id: ObjectId, val asset: AssetId, val rect: RectPt,
77	                       val rotationDeg: Float, val crop: RectF01) : PageObject   // crop normalized 0..1
78	data class StickyNote(override val id: ObjectId, val flow: FlowId, val rect: RectPt,
79	                      val rotationDeg: Float, val argb: Int) : PageObject
80	data class Attachment(override val id: ObjectId, val asset: AssetId, val displayName: String,
81	                      val mime: String, val position: PointPt) : PageObject
82	data class TextFlow(val id: FlowId, val markdown: String, val style: FlowStyle, val autoContinue: Boolean)
83	data class FlowStyle(val fontFamily: String, val sizeRatio: Float, val paragraphGapLines: Int,
84	                     val align: TextAlign)
85	```
86	Z-order rules: new objects go on top. Body flow frames are created at the bottom of the z-order so ink drawn later lies above text. Highlighter strokes are ordinary strokes drawn with transparency.
87	Tables, links, math, checklists live inside flow Markdown, not as page objects.
88	
89	## Commands and undo
90	- `EditCommand.execute(doc: Document): Applied` where `Applied(doc, inverse: EditCommand, coalesceKey: String?)`. The inverse is computed from the pre-state at execution time.
91	- Commands: `AddObjects(pageId, objects, atIndex?)`, `RemoveObjects(pageId, ids)`, `ReplaceObjects(pageId, removed, added)` (eraser split, shape recognition; added objects take the z-slot of the lowest removed one), `TransformObjects(pageId, ids, affine)`, `RecolorObjects`, `ReorderObjects(pageId, ids, op)`, `EditFlow(flowId, edits)` (text range edits `TextEdit(start, end, replacement)`; block edits map onto them), `InsertPages`, `RemovePages`, `MovePages`, `UpdatePageSpec`, `UpdateBackground`, `UpdateMeta`, `UpdateFlows(put, remove)`, `UpdateAssets(put, remove)`, `Batch(list)`. Exact inverses: `InsertObjectsAt`, `UpdateObjects` (in-place replace), `SetObjectOrder`, `RestorePages`, `SetPageOrder` (A-010).
92	- Every command declares `requiredPages` (bodies the session loads before executing) and an optional `coalesceKey`. Transforms keep local geometry of rotatable objects (shapes, images, sticky notes: center moves, sizes scale by the affine's axis scales, rotation adds; shear dropped); stroke samples map exactly and brush size scales with sqrt|det|.
93	- `UndoManager(capacity = 50)`: stack of `Applied` entries; `push`, `undo`, `redo`; redo stack cleared by push; entries with the same `coalesceKey` within 1000 ms merge (typing in one block, continuous slider drags). One pen/eraser/lasso gesture = one entry.
94	- Assets referenced by no object after undo history expiry are dropped at pack time (never while an undo entry may still need them).
95	
96	## Sessions
97	- `DocumentSession` (core:storage) owns: working copy, `StateFlow<Document>`, decoded page cache (LRU 30 pages; pages with pending edits are pinned), UndoManager, dirty set, autosave scheduler, pack triggers.
98	- Page decode happens on the io dispatcher; UI requests pages by visible range + prefetch 2 ahead/behind.
99	- Lifecycle: `open(path)` -> ready -> `execute/undo/redo` -> `close()` (final pack). App `onStop` packs all open sessions. Process death is covered by working copy recovery.
100	- Two panes may show the same document only read-only in the second pane (v1 rule; avoids concurrent sessions on one file).
101	- Implementation (A-015): `DocumentSessions` (singleton) opens one `DocumentSession` per document and packs all on `onAppStop()` (wired by :app to ProcessLifecycleOwner). The session loads `requiredPages` before execute/undo/redo, pins pages until their autosave is written, evicts least recently used clean pages beyond 30, writes `manifest.json` + `search/text.txt` after every edit with `modifiedMs` = time of the last edit (kept out of `Document` so undo stays exact), and indexes the file after each pack. Start-up recovery runs once when the library entry first finds access granted.

5	/** Result of an operation that can fail in an expected way (IO, parsing, permissions). */
6	sealed interface Outcome<out T> {
7	    /** The operation produced [value]. */
8	    data class Success<out T>(
9	        val value: T,
10	    ) : Outcome<T>
11	
12	    /** The operation failed; [message] is for logs, [cause] keeps the original exception if any. */
13	    data class Failure(
14	        val message: String,
15	        val cause: Throwable? = null,
16	    ) : Outcome<Nothing>
17	}
18	
19	/** Value on success, null on failure. */
20	fun <T> Outcome<T>.getOrNull(): T? = (this as? Outcome.Success)?.value
21	
22	/** Transforms the success value, keeps failures. */
23	inline fun <T, R> Outcome<T>.map(transform: (T) -> R): Outcome<R> =
24	    when (this) {
25	        is Outcome.Success -> Outcome.Success(transform(value))
26	        is Outcome.Failure -> this
27	    }
28	
29	/** Chains another fallible step. */
30	inline fun <T, R> Outcome<T>.flatMap(transform: (T) -> Outcome<R>): Outcome<R> =
31	    when (this) {
32	        is Outcome.Success -> transform(value)
33	        is Outcome.Failure -> this
34	    }
35	
36	/** Runs [block] and turns exceptions into [Outcome.Failure]. Cancellation is rethrown, never swallowed. */
37	@Suppress("TooGenericExceptionCaught") // Boundary helper: every non-cancellation exception becomes a Failure.
38	inline fun <T> outcomeOf(
39	    failureMessage: String,
40	    block: () -> T,
41	): Outcome<T> =
42	    try {
43	        Outcome.Success(block())
44	    } catch (e: CancellationException) {
45	        throw e
46	    } catch (e: Exception) {
47	        Outcome.Failure(failureMessage, e)
48	    }
