88	                    flows = persistentMapOf(),
89	                    assets = persistentMapOf(),
90	                    pageBodies = pages.associateBy { it.id }.toPersistentMap(),
91	                )
92	            val path = FileNames.unique(fs, spec.folder, FileNames.stemOf(spec.title), FileNames.FOLIO_EXT)
93	            fs
94	                .mkdirs(spec.folder)
95	                .flatMap { fs.writeAtomic(path) { out -> FolioContainerWriter.write(out, DocumentEntries.all(doc, app, emptyMap())) } }
96	                .map { DocumentRef(doc.meta.id, path) }
97	        }.also { indexed(it) }
98	
99	    /** Copies [path] beside it with a new document id; the title follows the new file name ("X (2)"). */
100	    suspend fun duplicate(path: String): Outcome<DocumentRef> =
101	        io {
102	            val stem = FileNames.nameOf(path).removeSuffix(FileNames.FOLIO_EXT)
103	            val target = FileNames.unique(fs, FileNames.parentOf(path), stem, FileNames.FOLIO_EXT)
104	            val id = DocId.random()
105	            val title = FileNames.nameOf(target).removeSuffix(FileNames.FOLIO_EXT)
106	            val now = clock.nowMs()
107	            rewriter
108	                .rewrite(path, target, ManifestPatch(id = id.value, title = title, createdMs = now, modifiedMs = now))
109	                .map { DocumentRef(id, target) }
110	        }.also { indexed(it) }
111	
112	    /** Sets the title and renames the file to match (collision -> " (2)"). */
113	    suspend fun rename(
114	        path: String,
115	        title: String,
116	    ): Outcome<String> =
117	        io {
118	            val stem = FileNames.stemOf(title)
119	            val sameName = FileNames.nameOf(path) == stem + FileNames.FOLIO_EXT
120	            val target = if (sameName) path else FileNames.unique(fs, FileNames.parentOf(path), stem, FileNames.FOLIO_EXT)
121	            rewriter.rewrite(path, target, ManifestPatch(title = title)).flatMap {
122	                if (target == path) Outcome.Success(target) else fs.delete(path).map { target }
123	            }
124	        }.also { result -> if (result is Outcome.Success) reindex(removed = listOf(path), added = result.value) }
125	
126	    /** Moves the file into [folder] (collision -> " (2)"). */
127	    suspend fun move(
128	        path: String,
129	        folder: String,
130	    ): Outcome<String> =
131	        io {
132	            val stem = FileNames.nameOf(path).removeSuffix(FileNames.FOLIO_EXT)
133	            val target = FileNames.unique(fs, folder, stem, FileNames.FOLIO_EXT)
134	            fs.move(path, target).map { target }
135	        }.also { result -> if (result is Outcome.Success) reindex(removed = listOf(path), added = result.value) }
136	
137	    /** Moves the file to the bin. */
138	    suspend fun delete(path: String): Outcome<BinEntry> {
139	        val docId = dao.document(path)?.docId
140	        return io { trash.moveToBin(path, docId) }
141	            .also { if (it is Outcome.Success) scanner.removeFiles(listOf(path)) }
142	            .also { refreshBin() }
143	    }
144	
145	    /** Moves a bin entry back to its original path; returns where it landed. */
146	    suspend fun restore(entry: BinEntry): Outcome<String> =
147	        io { trash.restore(entry) }
148	            .also { result ->
149	                if (result is Outcome.Success) {
150	                    if (entry.isFolder) scanner.incrementalScan() else scanner.indexFile(result.value)
151	                }
152	            }.also { refreshBin() }
153	
154	    /** Permanently deletes one bin entry (user confirmed). */
155	    suspend fun deleteForever(entry: BinEntry): Outcome<Unit> = io { trash.deleteForever(entry) }.also { refreshBin() }
156	
157	    /** Permanently deletes everything in the bin (user confirmed). Returns the count. */
158	    suspend fun emptyBin(): Outcome<Int> = io { trash.empty() }.also { refreshBin() }
159	
160	    /** Deletes bin entries older than [retentionDays]; null = keep forever. Returns the count. */
161	    suspend fun purgeBin(retentionDays: Int?): Outcome<Int> =
162	        if (retentionDays == null) Outcome.Success(0) else io { trash.purgeOlderThan(retentionDays) }.also { refreshBin() }
163	
164	    /** Re-reads the bin folder. */
165	    suspend fun refreshBin() {
166	        binState.value = withContext(dispatchers.io) { trash.entries() }
167	    }
168	
169	    internal suspend fun moveToBin(
170	        path: String,
171	        docId: String?,
172	    ): Outcome<BinEntry> = io { trash.moveToBin(path, docId) }.also { refreshBin() }
173	
174	    private suspend fun <T> io(block: () -> Outcome<T>): Outcome<T> = withContext(dispatchers.io) { block() }
175	
176	    private suspend fun indexed(result: Outcome<DocumentRef>) {
177	        if (result is Outcome.Success) scanner.indexFile(result.value.path)
178	    }
179	
180	    private suspend fun reindex(
181	        removed: List<String>,
182	        added: String,
183	    ) {
184	        scanner.removeFiles(removed.filter { it != added })
185	        scanner.indexFile(added)
186	    }
187	}

1	package dev.folio.core.storage.repo
2	
3	import dev.folio.core.common.Clock
4	import dev.folio.core.common.FolioFs
5	import dev.folio.core.common.Outcome
6	import dev.folio.core.common.flatMap
7	import dev.folio.core.common.getOrNull
8	import dev.folio.core.common.map
9	import dev.folio.core.storage.library.LibraryLayout
10	import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable
11	import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
12	
13	/** One item in the bin (09-storage-library.md#trash). */
14	data class BinEntry(
15	    /** Library path inside `.trash/`. */
16	    val trashPath: String,
17	    val originalPath: String,
18	    val deletedMs: Long,
19	    val docId: String?,
20	    val isFolder: Boolean,
21	) {
22	    /** Display name (original file or folder name). */
23	    val name: String get() = FileNames.nameOf(originalPath)
24	}
25	
26	@Serializable
27	private data class TrashSidecar(
28	    val originalPath: String,
29	    val deletedMs: Long,
30	    val docId: String? = null,
31	)
32	
33	private val SidecarJson =
34	    Json {
35	        ignoreUnknownKeys = true
36	        encodeDefaults = true
37	    }
38	
39	/**
40	 * `.trash/<epochMs>__<name>` plus sidecar `<same>.trash.json`. Permanent deletion only from here
41	 * (Delete forever, Empty bin, retention purge). Blocking IO: io dispatcher.
42	 */
43	internal class Bin(
44	    private val fs: FolioFs,
45	    private val clock: Clock,
46	) {
47	    fun moveToBin(
48	        path: String,
49	        docId: String?,
50	    ): Outcome<BinEntry> {
51	        val now = clock.nowMs()
52	        val stat = fs.stat(path) ?: return Outcome.Failure("$path does not exist")
53	        val base = "${LibraryLayout.TRASH}/${now}__${FileNames.nameOf(path)}"
54	        val trashPath = generateSequence(0) { it + 1 }.map { if (it == 0) base else "$base~$it" }.first { !fs.exists(it) }
55	        val sidecar = TrashSidecar(path, now, docId)
56	        return fs
57	            .writeBytesAtomic(sidecarOf(trashPath), SidecarJson.encodeToString(TrashSidecar.serializer(), sidecar).encodeToByteArray())
58	            .flatMap { fs.move(path, trashPath) }
59	            .map { BinEntry(trashPath, path, now, docId, stat.isDirectory) }
60	    }
61	
62	    fun entries(): List<BinEntry> {
63	        val children = fs.list(LibraryLayout.TRASH).getOrNull() ?: return emptyList()
64	        val names = children.associateBy { it.path }
65	        return children
66	            .filter { it.path.endsWith(SIDECAR_EXT) }
67	            .mapNotNull { side ->
68	                val trashPath = side.path.removeSuffix(SIDECAR_EXT)
69	                val item = names[trashPath] ?: return@mapNotNull null
70	                val meta =
71	                    fs.readBytes(side.path).getOrNull()?.let {
72	                        runCatching { SidecarJson.decodeFromString(TrashSidecar.serializer(), it.decodeToString()) }.getOrNull()
73	                    } ?: return@mapNotNull null
74	                BinEntry(trashPath, meta.originalPath, meta.deletedMs, meta.docId, item.isDirectory)
75	            }.sortedByDescending { it.deletedMs }
76	    }
77	
78	    /** Moves [entry] back to its original path (parents recreated; name collision -> " (2)"). Returns the new path. */
79	    fun restore(entry: BinEntry): Outcome<String> {
80	        val parent = FileNames.parentOf(entry.originalPath)
81	        val name = FileNames.nameOf(entry.originalPath)
82	        val ext = if (!entry.isFolder && name.endsWith(FileNames.FOLIO_EXT)) FileNames.FOLIO_EXT else ""
83	        val target = FileNames.unique(fs, parent, name.removeSuffix(ext), ext)
84	        return fs
85	            .mkdirs(parent)
86	            .flatMap { fs.move(entry.trashPath, target) }
87	            .flatMap { fs.delete(sidecarOf(entry.trashPath)) }
88	            .map { target }
89	    }
90	
91	    fun deleteForever(entry: BinEntry): Outcome<Unit> =
92	        fs.deleteRecursively(entry.trashPath).flatMap { fs.delete(sidecarOf(entry.trashPath)) }
93	
94	    /** Deletes every bin entry. Returns the number deleted. */
95	    fun empty(): Outcome<Int> = purge { true }
96	
97	    /** Deletes entries older than [retentionDays]. Returns the number deleted. */
98	    fun purgeOlderThan(retentionDays: Int): Outcome<Int> {
99	        val cutoff = clock.nowMs() - retentionDays * DAY_MS
100	        return purge { it.deletedMs < cutoff }
101	    }
102	
103	    private fun purge(which: (BinEntry) -> Boolean): Outcome<Int> {
104	        var count = 0
105	        for (entry in entries().filter(which)) {
106	            val r = deleteForever(entry)
107	            if (r is Outcome.Failure) return r
108	            count++
109	        }
110	        return Outcome.Success(count)
111	    }
112	
113	    private fun sidecarOf(trashPath: String) = "$trashPath$SIDECAR_EXT"
114	
115	    companion object {
116	        const val SIDECAR_EXT = ".trash.json"
117	        const val DAY_MS = 24L * 60 * 60 * 1000
118	    }
119	}

2	
3	import dev.folio.core.common.FolioFs
4	
5	/** File names derived from titles (09-storage-library.md#library-layout). */
6	object FileNames {
7	    /** `.folio` extension. */
8	    const val FOLIO_EXT = ".folio"
9	    private const val MAX_STEM = 120
10	    private val UNSAFE = Regex("[\\\\/:*?\"<>|\\p{Cntrl}]")
11	
12	    /** [title] as a file stem: invalid characters become '-', no leading dots, at most 120 chars, never empty. */
13	    fun stemOf(title: String): String =
14	        title
15	            .replace(UNSAFE, "-")
16	            .trim()
17	            .trimStart('.')
18	            .take(MAX_STEM)
19	            .trim()
20	            .ifEmpty { "Untitled" }
21	
22	    /** Library path in [dir] for [stem] + [ext] that does not exist yet: "Name", "Name (2)", "Name (3)", ... */
23	    fun unique(
24	        fs: FolioFs,
25	        dir: String,
26	        stem: String,
27	        ext: String,
28	    ): String {
29	        val candidates = sequenceOf(stem) + generateSequence(2) { it + 1 }.map { "$stem ($it)" }
30	        return candidates.map { join(dir, "$it$ext") }.first { !fs.exists(it) }
31	    }
32	
33	    /** Joins a library-relative directory and a name ("" is the root). */
34	    fun join(
35	        dir: String,
36	        name: String,
37	    ): String = if (dir.isEmpty()) name else "$dir/$name"
38	
39	    /** Parent directory of a library path ("" for the root). */
40	    fun parentOf(path: String): String = path.substringBeforeLast('/', "")
41	
42	    /** Last path segment. */
43	    fun nameOf(path: String): String = path.substringAfterLast('/')
44	}

3	import dev.folio.core.common.FolioDispatchers
4	import dev.folio.core.common.FolioFs
5	import dev.folio.core.common.Outcome
6	import dev.folio.core.common.flatMap
7	import dev.folio.core.common.map
8	import dev.folio.core.storage.index.DocumentRow
9	import dev.folio.core.storage.index.FolderRow
10	import dev.folio.core.storage.index.FtsQuery
11	import dev.folio.core.storage.index.IndexDao
12	import dev.folio.core.storage.index.LibraryScanner
13	import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow
14	import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.flow
15	import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.map
16	import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
17	import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonObject
18	import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonPrimitive
19	
20	/** Which documents a list shows (the bin comes from [DocumentRepository.bin]). */
21	sealed interface DocumentFilter {
22	    /** Documents directly in [folder] ("" = root). */
23	    data class InFolder(
24	        val folder: String,
25	    ) : DocumentFilter
26	
27	    /** Favorites anywhere. */
28	    data object Favorites : DocumentFilter
29	
30	    /** Documents with [tag]. */
31	    data class Tagged(
32	        val tag: String,
33	    ) : DocumentFilter
34	}
35	
36	/** List order. */
37	enum class DocumentSort { RECENT, NAME, CREATED }
38	
39	/**
40	 * Library views and organization (09-storage-library.md#repositories): folders, lists, search, tags,
41	 * favorites. Reads come from the index; writes go to the files and then update the index.
42	 */
43	@Suppress("TooManyFunctions") // One method per operation listed in 09-storage-library.md#repositories.
44	class LibraryRepository(
45	    private val fs: FolioFs,
46	    private val scanner: LibraryScanner,
47	    private val dao: IndexDao,
48	    private val dispatchers: FolioDispatchers,
49	    private val documents: DocumentRepository,
50	) {
51	    private val rewriter = ContainerRewriter(fs)
52	
53	    /** All visible folders ordered by path (the UI builds the tree from `parentPath`). */
54	    fun folderTree(): Flow<List<FolderRow>> = dao.folders()
55	
56	    /** Documents for [filter] in [sort] order. */
57	    fun documents(
58	        filter: DocumentFilter,
59	        sort: DocumentSort = DocumentSort.RECENT,
60	    ): Flow<List<DocumentRow>> {
61	        val source =
62	            when (filter) {
63	                is DocumentFilter.InFolder -> dao.documentsIn(filter.folder)
64	                DocumentFilter.Favorites -> dao.favorites()
65	                is DocumentFilter.Tagged -> dao.documentsWithTag(filter.tag)
66	            }
67	        return source.map { rows -> sorted(rows, sort) }
68	    }
69	
70	    /** Prefix search over title and text; title matches first, then newest. Blank queries give nothing. */
71	    fun search(query: String): Flow<List<DocumentRow>> =
72	        flow {
73	            val match = FtsQuery.of(query)
74	            if (match == null) {
75	                emit(emptyList())
76	                return@flow
77	            }
78	            val tokens = match.split(' ').map { it.removeSuffix("*") }
79	            val rows = withContext(dispatchers.io) { dao.search(match) }
80	            emit(rows.sortedByDescending { row -> titleHit(row.title, tokens) })
81	        }
82	
83	    /** All tags in use. */
84	    fun tags(): Flow<List<String>> = dao.allTags()
85	
86	    /** Marks a closed document as favorite (manifest rewrite). */
87	    suspend fun setFavorite(
88	        path: String,
89	        favorite: Boolean,
90	    ): Outcome<Unit> = patch(path, ManifestPatch(favorite = favorite))
91	
92	    /** Replaces the tags of a closed document. */
93	    suspend fun setTags(
94	        path: String,
95	        tags: Set<String>,
96	    ): Outcome<Unit> =
97	        patch(
98	            path,
99	            ManifestPatch(
100	                tags =
101	                    tags
102	                        .map { it.trim() }
103	                        .filter { it.isNotEmpty() }
104	                        .distinct()
105	                        .sorted(),
106	            ),
107	        )
108	
109	    /** Creates folder [name] in [parent]; returns its path (collision -> " (2)"). */
110	    suspend fun createFolder(
111	        parent: String,
112	        name: String,
113	    ): Outcome<String> =
114	        folderOp {
115	            val path = FileNames.unique(fs, parent, FileNames.stemOf(name), "")
116	            fs.mkdirs(path).map { path }
117	        }
118	
119	    /** Renames a folder; returns the new path. */
120	    suspend fun renameFolder(
121	        path: String,
122	        name: String,
123	    ): Outcome<String> =
124	        folderOp {
125	            val target = FileNames.unique(fs, FileNames.parentOf(path), FileNames.stemOf(name), "")
126	            fs.move(path, target).map { target }
127	        }
128	
129	    /** Moves a folder into [parent]; returns the new path. */
130	    suspend fun moveFolder(
131	        path: String,
132	        parent: String,
133	    ): Outcome<String> =
134	        folderOp {
135	            require(parent != path && !parent.startsWith("$path/")) { "cannot move a folder into itself" }
136	            val target = FileNames.unique(fs, parent, FileNames.nameOf(path), "")
137	            fs.move(path, target).map { target }
138	        }
139	
140	    /** Sets the folder tint (`.folder.json`); null removes it. */
141	    suspend fun setFolderTint(
142	        path: String,
143	        tint: String?,
144	    ): Outcome<Unit> =
145	        folderOp {
146	            val json = JsonObject(if (tint == null) emptyMap() else mapOf("tint" to JsonPrimitive(tint)))
147	            fs.writeBytesAtomic("$path/${LibraryScanner.FOLDER_JSON}", json.toString().encodeToByteArray())
148	        }
149	
150	    /** Moves a folder with its contents to the bin. */
151	    suspend fun deleteFolder(path: String): Outcome<BinEntry> = documents.moveToBin(path, null).also { scanner.incrementalScan() }
152	
153	    private suspend fun patch(
154	        path: String,
155	        patch: ManifestPatch,
156	    ): Outcome<Unit> =
157	        withContext(dispatchers.io) { rewriter.rewrite(path, path, patch) }
158	            .flatMap { Outcome.Success(Unit) }
159	            .also { if (it is Outcome.Success) scanner.indexFile(path) }
160	
161	    private suspend fun <T> folderOp(block: () -> Outcome<T>): Outcome<T> =
162	        withContext(dispatchers.io) { block() }.also { if (it is Outcome.Success) scanner.incrementalScan() }
163	
164	    private companion object {
165	        fun sorted(
166	            rows: List<DocumentRow>,
167	            sort: DocumentSort,
168	        ): List<DocumentRow> =
169	            when (sort) {
170	                DocumentSort.RECENT -> rows.sortedByDescending { it.modifiedMs }
171	                DocumentSort.NAME -> rows.sortedWith(compareBy(String.CASE_INSENSITIVE_ORDER) { it.title })
172	                DocumentSort.CREATED -> rows.sortedByDescending { it.createdMs }
173	            }
174	
175	        fun titleHit(
176	            title: String,
177	            tokens: List<String>,
178	        ): Boolean {
179	            val words = title.lowercase().split(Regex("[^\\p{L}\\p{N}]+"))
180	            return tokens.all { t -> words.any { it.startsWith(t) } }
181	        }
182	    }
183	}

3	import dev.folio.core.common.Clock
4	import dev.folio.core.model.Document
5	import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
6	import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
7	import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
8	
9	/**
10	 * Undo/redo history of inverse commands (03-document-model.md#commands-and-undo). Keeps at most
11	 * [capacity] undo entries (oldest dropped). A push whose coalesce key equals the top entry's key within
12	 * [coalesceWindowMs] of that entry's last push merges into it. Undo and redo end a coalescing run.
13	 * Not thread-safe: the owning session calls it from one thread.
14	 */
15	class UndoManager(
16	    private val clock: Clock,
17	    val capacity: Int = DEFAULT_CAPACITY,
18	    private val coalesceWindowMs: Long = DEFAULT_COALESCE_WINDOW_MS,
19	) {
20	    private class Entry(
21	        val command: EditCommand,
22	        val key: String?,
23	        val lastPushNs: Long,
24	    )
25	
26	    private val undoStack = ArrayDeque<Entry>()
27	    private val redoStack = ArrayDeque<Entry>()
28	    private var coalesceOpen = false
29	    private val canUndoState = MutableStateFlow(false)
30	    private val canRedoState = MutableStateFlow(false)
31	
32	    init {
33	        require(capacity > 0) { "capacity must be positive" }
34	    }
35	
36	    /** True while an undo entry exists. */
37	    val canUndo: StateFlow<Boolean> = canUndoState.asStateFlow()
38	
39	    /** True while a redo entry exists. */
40	    val canRedo: StateFlow<Boolean> = canRedoState.asStateFlow()
41	
42	    /** Number of undo entries. */
43	    val undoDepth: Int get() = undoStack.size
44	
45	    /** Number of redo entries. */
46	    val redoDepth: Int get() = redoStack.size
47	
48	    /** Command [undo] will execute next (so the session can load its [EditCommand.requiredPages]). */
49	    val nextUndo: EditCommand? get() = undoStack.lastOrNull()?.command
50	
51	    /** Command [redo] will execute next. */
52	    val nextRedo: EditCommand? get() = redoStack.lastOrNull()?.command
53	
54	    /** Records an executed command. Clears the redo stack. */
55	    fun push(applied: Applied) {
56	        redoStack.clear()
57	        val now = clock.monotonicNs()
58	        val top = undoStack.lastOrNull()
59	        val key = applied.coalesceKey
60	        if (top != null && canMerge(top, key, now)) {
61	            undoStack.removeLast()
62	            undoStack.addLast(Entry(merge(applied.inverse, top.command), key, now))
63	        } else {
64	            undoStack.addLast(Entry(applied.inverse, key, now))
65	            if (undoStack.size > capacity) undoStack.removeFirst()
66	        }
67	        coalesceOpen = true
68	        publish()
69	    }
70	
71	    /** Reverts the newest entry on [doc]; returns the result, or null if there is nothing to undo. */
72	    fun undo(doc: Document): Applied? {
73	        val entry = undoStack.removeLastOrNull() ?: return null
74	        val applied = entry.command.execute(doc)
75	        redoStack.addLast(Entry(applied.inverse, entry.key, 0L))
76	        coalesceOpen = false
77	        publish()
78	        return applied
79	    }
80	
81	    /** Re-applies the newest undone entry on [doc]; returns the result, or null if there is nothing to redo. */
82	    fun redo(doc: Document): Applied? {
83	        val entry = redoStack.removeLastOrNull() ?: return null
84	        val applied = entry.command.execute(doc)
85	        undoStack.addLast(Entry(applied.inverse, entry.key, clock.monotonicNs()))
86	        coalesceOpen = false
87	        publish()
88	        return applied
89	    }
90	
91	    /** Drops all history (document reloaded). */
92	    fun clear() {
93	        undoStack.clear()
94	        redoStack.clear()
95	        coalesceOpen = false
96	        publish()
97	    }
98	
99	    private fun canMerge(
100	        top: Entry,
101	        key: String?,
102	        nowNs: Long,
103	    ): Boolean {
104	        val sameRun = coalesceOpen && key != null && top.key == key
105	        return sameRun && nowNs - top.lastPushNs <= coalesceWindowMs * NS_PER_MS
106	    }
107	
108	    private fun publish() {
109	        canUndoState.value = undoStack.isNotEmpty()
110	        canRedoState.value = redoStack.isNotEmpty()
111	    }
112	
113	    // Newest inverse runs first. Flattened so a long typing burst stays one flat batch.
114	    private fun merge(
115	        newer: EditCommand,
116	        older: EditCommand,
117	    ): EditCommand {
118	        val olderList = if (older is Batch && older.coalesceKey == null) older.commands else listOf(older)
119	        return Batch(listOf(newer) + olderList)
120	    }
121	
122	    /** Defaults from 03-document-model.md#commands-and-undo. */
123	    companion object {
124	        /** Maximum undo entries. */
125	        const val DEFAULT_CAPACITY = 50
126	
127	        /** Coalescing window in ms. */
128	        const val DEFAULT_COALESCE_WINDOW_MS = 1000L
129	
130	        private const val NS_PER_MS = 1_000_000L
131	    }
132	}

7	/**
8	 * A document change. Executing is pure: it returns the new document and the exact inverse computed
9	 * from the pre-state. Invalid arguments (unknown ids, page body not loaded) are programmer errors and
10	 * throw IllegalArgumentException / IllegalStateException; the session validates UI input first.
11	 */
12	sealed interface EditCommand {
13	    /** Pages whose bodies must be loaded in [Document.pageBodies] before [execute]. */
14	    val requiredPages: Set<PageId>
15	
16	    /** Undo entries with the same non-null key within the coalescing window merge (typing, slider drags). */
17	    val coalesceKey: String?
18	
19	    /** Applies the command to [doc]. */
20	    fun execute(doc: Document): Applied
21	}
22	
23	/** Result of [EditCommand.execute]: new document, inverse command and the command's coalescing key. */
24	data class Applied(
25	    val doc: Document,
26	    val inverse: EditCommand,
27	    val coalesceKey: String?,
28	)
29	
30	/** Several commands as one undo step; the inverse runs the inverses in reverse order. */
31	data class Batch(
32	    val commands: List<EditCommand>,
33	    override val coalesceKey: String? = null,
34	) : EditCommand {
35	    override val requiredPages: Set<PageId> get() = commands.flatMapTo(HashSet()) { it.requiredPages }
36	
37	    override fun execute(doc: Document): Applied {
38	        var current = doc
39	        val inverses = ArrayList<EditCommand>(commands.size)
40	        for (command in commands) {
41	            val applied = command.execute(current)
42	            current = applied.doc
43	            inverses += applied.inverse
44	        }
45	        inverses.reverse()
46	        return Applied(current, Batch(inverses), coalesceKey)
47	    }
48	}
49	
50	internal fun Document.requireBody(pageId: PageId): Page =
51	    checkNotNull(pageBodies[pageId]) { "page ${pageId.value} is not loaded (or does not exist)" }
52	
53	/** Stores [page] as the loaded body and refreshes its summary (invariant: ref == body.toRef()). */
54	internal fun Document.withBody(page: Page): Document {
55	    val index = indexOfPage(page.id)
56	    check(index >= 0) { "page ${page.id.value} is not in the page list" }
57	    return copy(pages = pages.set(index, page.toRef()), pageBodies = pageBodies.put(page.id, page))
58	}

3	import dev.folio.core.model.Background
4	import dev.folio.core.model.Document
5	import dev.folio.core.model.Page
6	import dev.folio.core.model.PageId
7	import dev.folio.core.model.PageSpec
8	import kotlinx.collections.immutable.mutate
9	import kotlinx.collections.immutable.toPersistentList

11	/** A page with its position in the page list. */
12	data class IndexedPage(
13	    val index: Int,
14	    val page: Page,
15	)
16	
17	/** Inserts new pages (with bodies) at [atIndex], clamped to the page count. */
18	data class InsertPages(
19	    val atIndex: Int,
20	    val pages: List<Page>,
21	) : EditCommand {
22	    override val requiredPages: Set<PageId> get() = emptySet()
23	    override val coalesceKey: String? get() = null
24	
25	    override fun execute(doc: Document): Applied {
26	        val start = atIndex.coerceIn(0, doc.pages.size)
27	        return RestorePages(pages.mapIndexed { i, p -> IndexedPage(start + i, p) }).execute(doc)
28	    }
29	}
30	
31	/** Inserts pages at exact indices (ascending; each index is the final position). Inverse of removal. */
32	data class RestorePages(
33	    val entries: List<IndexedPage>,
34	) : EditCommand {
35	    override val requiredPages: Set<PageId> get() = emptySet()
36	    override val coalesceKey: String? get() = null
37	
38	    override fun execute(doc: Document): Applied {
39	        val existing = doc.pages.mapTo(HashSet()) { it.id }
40	        val refs = doc.pages.builder()
41	        val bodies = doc.pageBodies.builder()
42	        for (entry in entries.sortedBy { it.index }) {
43	            require(existing.add(entry.page.id)) { "page ${entry.page.id.value} already exists" }
44	            require(entry.index in 0..refs.size) { "index ${entry.index} out of range" }
45	            refs.add(entry.index, entry.page.toRef())
46	            bodies[entry.page.id] = entry.page
47	        }
48	        val newDoc = doc.copy(pages = refs.build(), pageBodies = bodies.build())
49	        return Applied(newDoc, RemovePages(entries.map { it.page.id }), null)
50	    }
51	}
52	
53	/** Removes pages (their bodies must be loaded so undo can restore them). */
54	data class RemovePages(
55	    val ids: List<PageId>,
56	) : EditCommand {
57	    override val requiredPages: Set<PageId> get() = ids.toSet()
58	    override val coalesceKey: String? get() = null
59	
60	    override fun execute(doc: Document): Applied {
61	        val idSet = ids.toHashSet()
62	        val removed = ArrayList<IndexedPage>(idSet.size)
63	        doc.pages.forEachIndexed { i, ref -> if (ref.id in idSet) removed += IndexedPage(i, doc.requireBody(ref.id)) }
64	        require(removed.size == idSet.size) { "unknown page id" }
65	        val newDoc =
66	            doc.copy(
67	                pages = doc.pages.removeAll { it.id in idSet },
68	                pageBodies = doc.pageBodies.mutate { m -> idSet.forEach { m.remove(it) } },
69	            )
70	        return Applied(newDoc, RestorePages(removed), null)
71	    }
72	}
73	
74	/** Moves [ids] as one block (in their current relative order) to [toIndex] of the remaining pages. */
75	data class MovePages(
76	    val ids: List<PageId>,
77	    val toIndex: Int,
78	) : EditCommand {
79	    override val requiredPages: Set<PageId> get() = emptySet()
80	    override val coalesceKey: String? get() = null
81	
82	    override fun execute(doc: Document): Applied {
83	        val idSet = ids.toHashSet()
84	        val order = doc.pages.map { it.id }
85	        val moving = order.filter { it in idSet }
86	        require(moving.size == idSet.size) { "unknown page id" }
87	        val rest = order.filter { it !in idSet }.toMutableList()
88	        rest.addAll(toIndex.coerceIn(0, rest.size), moving)
89	        return SetPageOrder(rest).execute(doc)
90	    }
91	}
92	
93	/** Sets the complete page order ([order] must be a permutation of the page ids). */
94	data class SetPageOrder(
95	    val order: List<PageId>,
96	) : EditCommand {
97	    override val requiredPages: Set<PageId> get() = emptySet()
98	    override val coalesceKey: String? get() = null
99	
100	    override fun execute(doc: Document): Applied {
101	        val byId = doc.pages.associateBy { it.id }
102	        require(order.size == byId.size && order.toHashSet() == byId.keys) { "order is not a permutation" }
103	        val newDoc = doc.copy(pages = order.map { byId.getValue(it) }.toPersistentList())
104	        return Applied(newDoc, SetPageOrder(doc.pages.map { it.id }), null)
105	    }
106	}
107	
108	/** Changes the page geometry (size, orientation, infinite). */
109	data class UpdatePageSpec(
110	    val pageId: PageId,
111	    val spec: PageSpec,
112	    override val coalesceKey: String? = null,
113	) : EditCommand {
114	    override val requiredPages: Set<PageId> get() = setOf(pageId)
115	
116	    override fun execute(doc: Document): Applied {
117	        val page = doc.requireBody(pageId)
118	        return Applied(doc.withBody(page.copy(spec = spec)), UpdatePageSpec(pageId, page.spec, coalesceKey), coalesceKey)
119	    }
120	}
121	
122	/** Changes paper color, template or PDF background of a page. */
123	data class UpdateBackground(
124	    val pageId: PageId,
125	    val background: Background,
126	    override val coalesceKey: String? = null,
127	) : EditCommand {
128	    override val requiredPages: Set<PageId> get() = setOf(pageId)
129	
130	    override fun execute(doc: Document): Applied {
131	        val page = doc.requireBody(pageId)
132	        val inverse = UpdateBackground(pageId, page.background, coalesceKey)
133	        return Applied(doc.withBody(page.copy(background = background)), inverse, coalesceKey)
134	    }
135	}

18	/**
19	 * Object moved by [affine]. Strokes map every sample (brush size scales with sqrt|det|). Rotatable
20	 * objects (shapes, images, sticky notes) keep their local geometry: the center moves, width/height
21	 * scale by the affine's axis scales and the rotation angle is added; shear is dropped. Frames map to
22	 * the bounds of their mapped rect (they never rotate). Attachments move their anchor.
23	 */
24	fun PageObject.transformed(affine: Affine): PageObject =
25	    when (this) {
26	        is InkStroke -> {
27	            val scale = sqrt(abs(affine.determinant))
28	            InkStroke.of(id, brush.copy(sizePt = brush.sizePt * scale), inputs.transformed(affine))
29	        }
30	
31	        is Shape -> {
32	            transformShape(this, affine)
33	        }
34	
35	        is FlowFrame -> {
36	            copy(rect = affine.mapRect(rect))
37	        }
38	
39	        is ImageObject -> {
40	            val (r, deg) = transformRotatedRect(rect, rotationDeg, affine)
41	            copy(rect = r, rotationDeg = deg)
42	        }
43	
44	        is StickyNote -> {
45	            val (r, deg) = transformRotatedRect(rect, rotationDeg, affine)
46	            copy(rect = r, rotationDeg = deg)
47	        }
48	
49	        is Attachment -> {
50	            copy(position = affine.mapPoint(position))
51	        }
52	    }
53	
54	/** Object with its primary color set to [argb]; objects without a color are returned unchanged. */
55	fun PageObject.recolored(argb: Int): PageObject =
56	    when (this) {
57	        is InkStroke -> copy(brush = brush.copy(argb = argb))
58	        is Shape -> copy(stroke = stroke.copy(argb = argb))
59	        is StickyNote -> copy(argb = argb)
60	        is FlowFrame, is ImageObject, is Attachment -> this
61	    }
62	
63	/** Bounds of a shape: its points' bounds rotated around their center, grown by half the outline width. */
64	fun shapeBounds(
65	    points: List<PointPt>,
66	    rotationDeg: Float,
67	    widthPt: Float,
68	): RectPt {
69	    val local = RectPt.bounds(points)
70	    if (local.isEmpty) return local
71	    val c = local.center
72	    val rotated = if (rotationDeg == 0f) local else Affine.rotate(rotationDeg, c.x, c.y).mapRect(local)
73	    return rotated.inset(-widthPt / 2f)
74	}
75	
76	private fun axisScales(affine: Affine): Pair<Float, Float> = hypot(affine.a, affine.b) to hypot(affine.c, affine.d)
77	
78	private fun rotationOf(affine: Affine): Float = Math.toDegrees(atan2(affine.b, affine.a).toDouble()).toFloat()
79	
80	private fun transformShape(
81	    shape: Shape,
82	    affine: Affine,
83	): Shape {
84	    val local = RectPt.bounds(shape.points)
85	    if (local.isEmpty) return shape
86	    val c = local.center
87	    val newC = affine.mapPoint(c)
88	    val (sx, sy) = axisScales(affine)
89	    val points = shape.points.map { PointPt(newC.x + (it.x - c.x) * sx, newC.y + (it.y - c.y) * sy) }
90	    val deg = shape.rotationDeg + rotationOf(affine)
91	    val width = shape.stroke.widthPt * sqrt(abs(affine.determinant))
92	    return shape.copy(
93	        points = points,
94	        rotationDeg = deg,
95	        stroke = shape.stroke.copy(widthPt = width),
96	        bounds = shapeBounds(points, deg, width),
97	    )
98	}
99	
100	private fun transformRotatedRect(
101	    rect: RectPt,
102	    rotationDeg: Float,
103	    affine: Affine,
104	): Pair<RectPt, Float> {
105	    val c = affine.mapPoint(rect.center)
106	    val (sx, sy) = axisScales(affine)
107	    val w = rect.widthPt * sx
108	    val h = rect.heightPt * sy
109	    return RectPt(c.x - w / 2f, c.y - h / 2f, c.x + w / 2f, c.y + h / 2f) to rotationDeg + rotationOf(affine)
110	}

3	import dev.folio.core.model.InputTool
4	import dev.folio.core.model.StrokeInputs
5	import kotlin.math.roundToLong
6	import dev.folio.core.format.proto.v1.InputTool as PbInputTool
7	import dev.folio.core.format.proto.v1.StrokeInputs as PbStrokeInputs
8	
9	/**
10	 * Quantized delta encoding of stroke samples (04-file-format.md#stroke-encoding): positions in 1/64 pt,
11	 * time in 0.1 ms, pressure 0..1023, tilt and orientation in 0.1 deg. Quantization is applied to the
12	 * absolute values first and deltas are taken between quantized values, so errors never accumulate.
13	 */
14	internal object StrokeCodec {
15	    const val POS_UNITS_PER_PT = 64.0
16	    const val TIME_UNITS_PER_MS = 10.0
17	    const val PRESSURE_MAX = 1023
18	    const val ANGLE_UNITS_PER_DEG = 10.0
19	    private const val TILT_MAX = 900
20	    private const val ORIENTATION_MAX = 1800
21	
22	    /** Max samples accepted from a file (untrusted input bound). */
23	    const val MAX_SAMPLES = 1_000_000
24	
25	    fun encode(inputs: StrokeInputs): PbStrokeInputs {
26	        val n = inputs.size
27	        val qx = LongArray(n) { (inputs.x[it] * POS_UNITS_PER_PT).roundToLong() }
28	        val qy = LongArray(n) { (inputs.y[it] * POS_UNITS_PER_PT).roundToLong() }
29	        val qt = LongArray(n) { (inputs.tMs[it] * TIME_UNITS_PER_MS).roundToLong() }
30	        return PbStrokeInputs(
31	            origin_x = if (n == 0) 0L else qx[0],
32	            origin_y = if (n == 0) 0L else qy[0],
33	            dx = deltas(qx),
34	            dy = deltas(qy),
35	            dt = deltas(qt),
36	            pressure = inputs.pressure?.map { (it * PRESSURE_MAX).roundToLong().toInt().coerceIn(0, PRESSURE_MAX) } ?: emptyList(),
37	            tilt = inputs.tiltDeg?.map { (it * ANGLE_UNITS_PER_DEG).roundToLong().toInt().coerceIn(0, TILT_MAX) } ?: emptyList(),
38	            orientation =
39	                inputs.orientationDeg?.map {
40	                    (it * ANGLE_UNITS_PER_DEG).roundToLong().toInt().coerceIn(-ORIENTATION_MAX, ORIENTATION_MAX)
41	                } ?: emptyList(),
42	            tool = encodeTool(inputs.tool),
43	        )
44	    }
45	
46	    /** Throws [CorruptDataException] for inconsistent channel sizes. */
47	    fun decode(pb: PbStrokeInputs): StrokeInputs {
48	        val n = pb.dx.size
49	        corruptIf(n > MAX_SAMPLES) { "stroke has $n samples" }
50	        corruptIf(pb.dy.size != n || pb.dt.size != n) { "stroke channel sizes differ" }
51	        corruptIf(pb.pressure.isNotEmpty() && pb.pressure.size != n) { "pressure size differs" }
52	        corruptIf(pb.tilt.isNotEmpty() && pb.tilt.size != n) { "tilt size differs" }
53	        corruptIf(pb.orientation.isNotEmpty() && pb.orientation.size != n) { "orientation size differs" }
54	        return StrokeInputs(
55	            x = integrate(pb.origin_x, pb.dx, POS_UNITS_PER_PT),
56	            y = integrate(pb.origin_y, pb.dy, POS_UNITS_PER_PT),
57	            tMs = integrate(0L, pb.dt, TIME_UNITS_PER_MS),
58	            pressure = if (pb.pressure.isEmpty()) null else FloatArray(n) { pb.pressure[it].toFloat() / PRESSURE_MAX },
59	            tiltDeg = if (pb.tilt.isEmpty()) null else FloatArray(n) { (pb.tilt[it] / ANGLE_UNITS_PER_DEG).toFloat() },
60	            orientationDeg =
61	                if (pb.orientation.isEmpty()) null else FloatArray(n) { (pb.orientation[it] / ANGLE_UNITS_PER_DEG).toFloat() },
62	            tool = decodeTool(pb.tool),
63	        )
64	    }
65	
66	    private fun deltas(q: LongArray): List<Int> {
67	        val out = ArrayList<Int>(q.size)
68	        for (i in q.indices) {
69	            val d = if (i == 0) 0L else q[i] - q[i - 1]
70	            require(d in Int.MIN_VALUE..Int.MAX_VALUE) { "stroke delta out of range: $d" }
71	            out += d.toInt()
72	        }
73	        return out
74	    }
75	
76	    private fun integrate(
77	        origin: Long,
78	        deltas: List<Int>,
79	        unitsPerValue: Double,
80	    ): FloatArray {
81	        val out = FloatArray(deltas.size)
82	        var q = origin
83	        for (i in deltas.indices) {
84	            q += deltas[i]
85	            out[i] = (q / unitsPerValue).toFloat()
86	        }
87	        return out
88	    }
89	
90	    private fun encodeTool(tool: InputTool): PbInputTool =
91	        when (tool) {
92	            InputTool.STYLUS -> PbInputTool.STYLUS
93	            InputTool.ERASER_END -> PbInputTool.ERASER_END
94	            InputTool.SYNTHETIC -> PbInputTool.SYNTHETIC
95	        }
96	
97	    private fun decodeTool(tool: PbInputTool): InputTool =
98	        when (tool) {
99	            PbInputTool.ERASER_END -> InputTool.ERASER_END
100	            PbInputTool.SYNTHETIC -> InputTool.SYNTHETIC
101	            PbInputTool.STYLUS, PbInputTool.INPUT_TOOL_UNSPECIFIED -> InputTool.STYLUS
102	        }
103	}
104	
105	/** Invalid content found while decoding; turned into `FormatError.Corrupt` at the codec boundary. */
106	internal class CorruptDataException(
107	    detail: String,
108	) : Exception(detail)
109	
110	internal inline fun corruptIf(
111	    condition: Boolean,
112	    detail: () -> String,
113	) {
114	    if (condition) throw CorruptDataException(detail())
115	}

3	import dev.folio.core.common.Outcome
4	import dev.folio.core.format.FormatError
5	import dev.folio.core.model.Page
6	import dev.folio.core.model.PageId
7	import dev.folio.core.model.PageSpec
8	import kotlinx.collections.immutable.toPersistentList
9	import java.io.IOException
10	import dev.folio.core.format.proto.v1.Page as PbPage
11	
12	/** Page body <-> `pages/<pageId>.pb` (folio.v1.Page). */
13	object PageCodec {
14	    /** Protobuf bytes of [page] (before DEFLATE). */
15	    fun encode(page: Page): ByteArray = PbPage.ADAPTER.encode(toProto(page))
16	
17	    /**
18	     * Decodes untrusted bytes. Failures carry [FormatError.Corrupt] for [entry]. Objects of kinds this
19	     * version does not know (newer writer) are skipped.
20	     */
21	    fun decode(
22	        bytes: ByteArray,
23	        entry: String,
24	    ): Outcome<Page> =
25	        try {
26	            Outcome.Success(fromProto(PbPage.ADAPTER.decode(bytes)))
27	        } catch (e: IOException) {
28	            corrupt(entry, "unreadable protobuf", e)
29	        } catch (e: CorruptDataException) {
30	            corrupt(entry, e.message.orEmpty(), e)
31	        } catch (e: IllegalArgumentException) {
32	            // Wire's generated constructors and model init blocks validate with require().
33	            corrupt(entry, e.message.orEmpty(), e)
34	        }
35	
36	    private fun corrupt(
37	        entry: String,
38	        detail: String,
39	        cause: Throwable,
40	    ): Outcome.Failure = Outcome.Failure("cannot decode $entry: $detail", FormatError.Corrupt(entry, detail, cause))
41	
42	    internal fun toProto(page: Page): PbPage =
43	        PbPage(
44	            id = page.id.value,
45	            spec = LayoutCodec.specToProto(page.spec),
46	            background = LayoutCodec.backgroundToProto(page.background),
47	            objects = page.objects.map(ObjectCodec::toProto),
48	            content_bounds = if (page.spec is PageSpec.Infinite) page.contentBounds()?.let(::rectToProto) else null,
49	        )
50	
51	    internal fun fromProto(pb: PbPage): Page {
52	        corruptIf(pb.id.isBlank()) { "page id missing" }
53	        val spec = LayoutCodec.specFromProto(pb.spec.orCorrupt("page spec"))
54	        val background = LayoutCodec.backgroundFromProto(pb.background.orCorrupt("background"))
55	        val objects = pb.objects.mapNotNull(ObjectCodec::fromProto)
56	        corruptIf(objects.distinctBy { it.id }.size != objects.size) { "duplicate object ids" }
57	        return Page(PageId(pb.id), spec, background, objects.toPersistentList())
58	    }
59	}

27	/** Page objects <-> proto. Unknown object kinds (all oneof members null) decode to null. */
28	internal object ObjectCodec {
29	    fun toProto(o: PageObject): PbPageObject {
30	        val id = o.id.value
31	        return when (o) {
32	            is InkStroke -> {
33	                PbPageObject(id = id, stroke = strokeToProto(o))
34	            }
35	
36	            is Shape -> {
37	                PbPageObject(id = id, shape = shapeToProto(o))
38	            }
39	
40	            is FlowFrame -> {
41	                PbPageObject(
42	                    id = id,
43	                    frame = PbFlowFrame(o.flow.value, rectToProto(o.rect), o.order, EnumCodec.frameRole(o.role), o.autoGrow),
44	                )
45	            }
46	
47	            is ImageObject -> {
48	                val crop = PbRect(o.crop.left, o.crop.top, o.crop.right, o.crop.bottom)
49	                PbPageObject(id = id, image = PbImage(o.asset.value, rectToProto(o.rect), o.rotationDeg, crop))
50	            }
51	
52	            is StickyNote -> {
53	                PbPageObject(id = id, sticky = PbStickyNote(o.flow.value, rectToProto(o.rect), o.rotationDeg, o.argb))
54	            }
55	
56	            is Attachment -> {
57	                PbPageObject(id = id, attachment = PbAttachment(o.asset.value, o.displayName, o.mime, pointToProto(o.position)))
58	            }
59	        }
60	    }
61	
62	    fun fromProto(pb: PbPageObject): PageObject? {
63	        corruptIf(pb.id.isBlank()) { "object id missing" }
64	        val id = ObjectId(pb.id)
65	        val stroke = pb.stroke
66	        val shape = pb.shape
67	        val frame = pb.frame
68	        val image = pb.image
69	        val sticky = pb.sticky
70	        val attachment = pb.attachment
71	        return when {
72	            stroke != null -> {
73	                strokeFromProto(id, stroke)
74	            }
75	
76	            shape != null -> {
77	                shapeFromProto(id, shape)
78	            }
79	
80	            frame != null -> {
81	                FlowFrame(
82	                    id,
83	                    FlowId(frame.flow_id),
84	                    rectFromProto(frame.rect, "frame rect"),
85	                    frame.order,
86	                    EnumCodec.frameRole(frame.role),
87	                    frame.auto_grow,
88	                )
89	            }
90	
91	            image != null -> {
92	                imageFromProto(id, image)
93	            }
94	
95	            sticky != null -> {
96	                StickyNote(id, FlowId(sticky.flow_id), rectFromProto(sticky.rect, "sticky rect"), sticky.rotation_deg, sticky.argb)
97	            }
98	
99	            attachment != null -> {
100	                Attachment(
101	                    id,
102	                    AssetId(attachment.asset),
103	                    attachment.display_name,
104	                    attachment.mime,
105	                    pointFromProto(attachment.position.orCorrupt("attachment position")),
106	                )
107	            }
108	
109	            else -> {
110	                null
111	            }
112	        }
113	    }
114	
115	    private fun strokeToProto(o: InkStroke): PbInkStroke =
116	        PbInkStroke(
117	            brush = PbBrushSpec(EnumCodec.brushKind(o.brush.kind), o.brush.argb, o.brush.sizePt, o.brush.version, o.brush.pressureGamma),
118	            inputs = StrokeCodec.encode(o.inputs),
119	            bounds = rectToProto(o.bounds),
120	        )
121	
122	    private fun strokeFromProto(
123	        id: ObjectId,
124	        pb: PbInkStroke,
125	    ): InkStroke {
126	        val b = pb.brush.orCorrupt("brush")
127	        val brush = BrushSpec(EnumCodec.brushKind(b.kind), b.argb, b.size_pt, b.version, b.pressure_gamma)
128	        return InkStroke(id, brush, StrokeCodec.decode(pb.inputs.orCorrupt("stroke inputs")), rectFromProto(pb.bounds, "stroke bounds"))
129	    }
130	
131	    private fun shapeToProto(o: Shape): PbShape =
132	        PbShape(
133	            kind = EnumCodec.shapeKind(o.kind),
134	            points = o.points.map(::pointToProto),
135	            rotation_deg = o.rotationDeg,
136	            stroke = PbStrokeStyle(o.stroke.argb, o.stroke.widthPt, o.stroke.dashed),
137	            fill_argb = o.fillArgb ?: 0,
138	            has_fill = o.fillArgb != null,
139	            bounds = rectToProto(o.bounds),
140	        )
141	
142	    private fun shapeFromProto(
143	        id: ObjectId,
144	        pb: PbShape,
145	    ): Shape {
146	        val style = pb.stroke.orCorrupt("shape style")
147	        return Shape(
148	            id = id,
149	            kind = EnumCodec.shapeKind(pb.kind),
150	            points = pb.points.map(::pointFromProto),
151	            rotationDeg = pb.rotation_deg,
152	            stroke = StrokeStyle(style.argb, style.width_pt, style.dashed),
153	            fillArgb = if (pb.has_fill) pb.fill_argb else null,
154	            bounds = rectFromProto(pb.bounds, "shape bounds"),
155	        )
156	    }
157	
158	    private fun imageFromProto(
159	        id: ObjectId,
160	        pb: PbImage,
161	    ): ImageObject {
162	        val crop = pb.crop?.let { RectF01(it.left, it.top, it.right, it.bottom) } ?: RectF01.FULL
163	        return ImageObject(id, AssetId(pb.asset), rectFromProto(pb.rect, "image rect"), pb.rotation_deg, crop)
164	    }
165	}

17	import dev.folio.core.format.proto.v1.Rect as PbRect

19	
20	/** Page spec and background <-> proto. */
21	internal object LayoutCodec {
22	    fun specToProto(spec: PageSpec): PbPageSpec =
23	        when (spec) {
24	            is PageSpec.Fixed -> {
25	                PbPageSpec(fixed = fixedToProto(spec))
26	            }
27	
28	            is PageSpec.Custom -> {
29	                PbPageSpec(custom = PbCustom(spec.widthPt, spec.heightPt))
30	            }
31	
32	            is PageSpec.Infinite -> {
33	                when (val origin = spec.origin) {
34	                    is PageSpec.Fixed -> PbPageSpec(infinite = PbInfinite(origin_fixed = fixedToProto(origin)))
35	                    is PageSpec.Custom -> PbPageSpec(infinite = PbInfinite(origin_custom = PbCustom(origin.widthPt, origin.heightPt)))
36	                    is PageSpec.Infinite -> error("nested infinite spec")
37	                }
38	            }
39	        }
40	
41	    fun specFromProto(pb: PbPageSpec): PageSpec {
42	        val fixed = pb.fixed
43	        val custom = pb.custom
44	        val infinite = pb.infinite
45	        return when {
46	            fixed != null -> fixedFromProto(fixed)
47	            custom != null -> customFromProto(custom)
48	            infinite != null -> PageSpec.Infinite(originFromProto(infinite))
49	            else -> throw CorruptDataException("page spec has no kind")
50	        }
51	    }
52	
53	    fun backgroundToProto(bg: Background): PbBackground =
54	        PbBackground(
55	            paper_argb = bg.paperArgb,
56	            template =
57	                PbTemplate(
58	                    kind = EnumCodec.templateKind(bg.template.kind),
59	                    spacing_pt = bg.template.spacingPt,
60	                    line_argb = bg.template.lineArgb,
61	                    margin_left_pt = bg.template.marginLeftPt,
62	                    margin_top_pt = bg.template.marginTopPt,
63	                    custom_asset =
64	                        bg.template.customAsset
65	                            ?.value
66	                            .orEmpty(),
67	                    custom_grid_pt = bg.template.customGridPt ?: 0f,
68	                ),
69	            pdf = bg.pdf?.let { PbPdfBackground(it.asset.value, it.pageIndex) },
70	        )
71	
72	    fun backgroundFromProto(pb: PbBackground): Background {
73	        val t = pb.template.orCorrupt("template")
74	        val template =
75	            Template(
76	                kind = EnumCodec.templateKind(t.kind),
77	                spacingPt = t.spacing_pt,
78	                lineArgb = t.line_argb,
79	                marginLeftPt = t.margin_left_pt,
80	                marginTopPt = t.margin_top_pt,
81	                customAsset = t.custom_asset.takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() }?.let(::AssetId),
82	                customGridPt = t.custom_grid_pt.takeIf { it != 0f },
83	            )
84	        val pdf =
85	            pb.pdf?.let {
86	                corruptIf(it.asset.isEmpty() || it.page_index < 0) { "pdf background invalid" }
87	                PdfBackground(AssetId(it.asset), it.page_index)
88	            }
89	        return Background(pb.paper_argb, template, pdf)
90	    }
91	
92	    private fun originFromProto(pb: PbInfinite): PageSpec {
93	        val fixed = pb.origin_fixed
94	        val custom = pb.origin_custom
95	        return when {
96	            fixed != null -> fixedFromProto(fixed)
97	            custom != null -> customFromProto(custom)
98	            else -> throw CorruptDataException("infinite page has no origin")
99	        }
100	    }
101	
102	    private fun fixedToProto(spec: PageSpec.Fixed): PbFixed =
103	        PbFixed(EnumCodec.paperSize(spec.size), EnumCodec.orientation(spec.orientation))
104	
105	    private fun fixedFromProto(pb: PbFixed): PageSpec.Fixed =
106	        PageSpec.Fixed(EnumCodec.paperSize(pb.size), EnumCodec.orientation(pb.orientation))
107	
108	    private fun customFromProto(pb: PbCustom): PageSpec.Custom {
109	        corruptIf(!(pb.width_pt > 0f && pb.height_pt > 0f)) { "custom page size ${pb.width_pt} x ${pb.height_pt}" }
110	        return PageSpec.Custom(pb.width_pt, pb.height_pt)
111	    }
112	}
113	
114	internal fun rectToProto(r: RectPt): PbRect = PbRect(r.left, r.top, r.right, r.bottom)
115	
116	internal fun rectFromProto(
117	    pb: PbRect?,
118	    what: String,
119	): RectPt = pb.orCorrupt(what).let { RectPt(it.left, it.top, it.right, it.bottom) }
120	
121	internal fun pointToProto(p: PointPt): PbPoint = PbPoint(p.x, p.y)
122	
123	internal fun pointFromProto(pb: PbPoint): PointPt = PointPt(pb.x, pb.y)
124	
125	/** Non-null value or [CorruptDataException] "<what> missing". */
126	internal fun <T : Any> T?.orCorrupt(what: String): T = this ?: throw CorruptDataException("$what missing")

29	/** Document <-> [Manifest]. Decoding throws [CorruptDataException]; callers wrap it into `FormatError.Corrupt`. */
30	internal object ManifestMapper {
31	    private const val DEFAULT_LINE_ARGB = 0xFFC9D3E0.toInt()
32	    private const val RECT_VALUES = 4
33	
34	    fun fromDocument(
35	        doc: Document,
36	        app: ManifestApp,
37	        links: List<String>,
38	        textPreview: String,
39	    ): Manifest {
40	        val defaultSpec = SpecFields.of(doc.meta.defaultPageSpec)
41	        val defaultBg = backgroundToJson(doc.meta.defaultBackground)
42	        return Manifest(
43	            formatVersion = Manifest.CURRENT_VERSION,
44	            id = doc.meta.id.value,
45	            title = doc.meta.title,
46	            createdMs = doc.meta.createdMs,
47	            modifiedMs = doc.meta.modifiedMs,
48	            app = app,
49	            tags = doc.meta.tags.toList(),
50	            favorite = doc.meta.favorite,
51	            pages = doc.pages.map(::pageToJson),
52	            flows = doc.flows.keys.map { it.value },
53	            assets = doc.assets.values.map { ManifestAsset(it.id.value, ManifestValues.assetPath(it), it.mime, it.bytes, it.originalName) },
54	            links = links,
55	            textPreview = textPreview,
56	            defaults =
57	                ManifestDefaults(
58	                    kind = defaultSpec.kind,
59	                    size = defaultSpec.size,
60	                    orientation = defaultSpec.orientation,
61	                    widthPt = defaultSpec.widthPt,
62	                    heightPt = defaultSpec.heightPt,
63	                    origin = defaultSpec.origin,
64	                    template = defaultBg.template.kind,
65	                    spacingPt = defaultBg.template.spacingPt,
66	                    paperArgb = defaultBg.paperArgb,
67	                    background = defaultBg,
68	                ),
69	        )
70	    }
71	
72	    /** Meta, page refs and asset infos; flows are read from their own entries. */
73	    fun toDocumentShell(m: Manifest): Document {
74	        corruptIf(m.format != Manifest.FORMAT_NAME) { "format is '${m.format}'" }
75	        corruptIf(m.id.isBlank()) { "document id missing" }
76	        val d = m.defaults
77	        val defaultSpec = SpecFields(d.kind, d.size, d.orientation, d.widthPt, d.heightPt, d.origin).toSpec()
78	        val defaultBg =
79	            d.background?.let(::backgroundFromJson)
80	                ?: Background(parseArgb(d.paperArgb), fallbackTemplate(d.template, d.spacingPt), null)
81	        val meta =
82	            DocumentMeta(
83	                id = DocId(m.id),
84	                title = m.title,
85	                createdMs = m.createdMs,
86	                modifiedMs = m.modifiedMs,
87	                tags = m.tags.toPersistentSet(),
88	                favorite = m.favorite,
89	                formatVersion = m.formatVersion,
90	                defaultPageSpec = defaultSpec,
91	                defaultBackground = defaultBg,
92	            )
93	        val pages = m.pages.map { pageFromJson(it, defaultBg) }
94	        corruptIf(pages.distinctBy { it.id }.size != pages.size) { "duplicate page ids" }
95	        val assets = m.assets.associate { AssetId(it.id) to AssetInfo(AssetId(it.id), it.mime, it.bytes, it.name) }
96	        return Document(meta, pages.toPersistentList(), persistentMapOf(), assets.toPersistentMap())
97	    }
98	
99	    fun flowStyleToJson(
100	        style: FlowStyle,
101	        autoContinue: Boolean,
102	    ): FlowStyleJson = FlowStyleJson(style.fontFamily, style.sizeRatio, style.paragraphGapLines, style.align.name.lowercase(), autoContinue)
103	
104	    fun flowStyleFromJson(json: FlowStyleJson): FlowStyle {
105	        val align = TextAlign.entries.firstOrNull { it.name.equals(json.align, ignoreCase = true) } ?: TextAlign.START
106	        return FlowStyle(json.fontFamily, json.sizeRatio, json.paragraphGapLines, align)
107	    }
108	
109	    private fun pageToJson(ref: PageRef): ManifestPage {
110	        val f = SpecFields.of(ref.spec)
111	        val bg = backgroundToJson(ref.background)
112	        return ManifestPage(
113	            id = ref.id.value,
114	            kind = f.kind,
115	            size = f.size,
116	            orientation = f.orientation,
117	            widthPt = ref.spec.widthPt,
118	            heightPt = ref.spec.heightPt,
119	            origin = f.origin,
120	            template = bg.template.kind,
121	            pdf = bg.pdf,
122	            contentBounds = ref.contentBounds?.let { listOf(it.left, it.top, it.right, it.bottom) },
123	            background = bg,
124	        )
125	    }
126	
127	    private fun pageFromJson(
128	        p: ManifestPage,
129	        defaultBg: Background,
130	    ): PageRef {
131	        corruptIf(p.id.isBlank()) { "page id missing" }
132	        val spec = SpecFields(p.kind, p.size, p.orientation, p.widthPt, p.heightPt, p.origin).toSpec()
133	        val background =
134	            p.background?.let(::backgroundFromJson)
135	                ?: Background(
136	                    defaultBg.paperArgb,
137	                    fallbackTemplate(p.template, defaultBg.template.spacingPt),
138	                    p.pdf?.let { PdfBackground(AssetId(it.asset), it.pageIndex) },
139	                )
140	        val bounds =
141	            p.contentBounds?.let {
142	                corruptIf(it.size != RECT_VALUES) { "contentBounds needs 4 values" }
143	                RectPt(it[0], it[1], it[2], it[3])
144	            }
145	        return PageRef(PageId(p.id), spec, background, if (spec is PageSpec.Infinite) bounds else null)
146	    }
147	
148	    private fun backgroundToJson(bg: Background): ManifestBackground =
149	        ManifestBackground(
150	            paperArgb = formatArgb(bg.paperArgb),
151	            template =
152	                ManifestTemplate(
153	                    kind = bg.template.kind.name,
154	                    spacingPt = bg.template.spacingPt,
155	                    lineArgb = formatArgb(bg.template.lineArgb),
156	                    marginLeftPt = bg.template.marginLeftPt,
157	                    marginTopPt = bg.template.marginTopPt,
158	                    customAsset = bg.template.customAsset?.value,
159	                    customGridPt = bg.template.customGridPt,
160	                ),
161	            pdf = bg.pdf?.let { ManifestPdf(it.asset.value, it.pageIndex) },
162	        )
163	
164	    private fun backgroundFromJson(bg: ManifestBackground): Background {
165	        val t = bg.template
166	        val template =
167	            Template(
168	                kind = templateKind(t.kind),
169	                spacingPt = t.spacingPt,
170	                lineArgb = parseArgb(t.lineArgb),
171	                marginLeftPt = t.marginLeftPt,
172	                marginTopPt = t.marginTopPt,
173	                customAsset = t.customAsset?.let(::AssetId),
174	                customGridPt = t.customGridPt,
175	            )
176	        return Background(parseArgb(bg.paperArgb), template, bg.pdf?.let { PdfBackground(AssetId(it.asset), it.pageIndex) })
177	    }
178	
179	    private fun fallbackTemplate(
180	        kind: String,
181	        spacingPt: Float,
182	    ): Template = Template(templateKind(kind), spacingPt, DEFAULT_LINE_ARGB, 0f, 0f, null, null)
183	
184	    private fun templateKind(name: String): TemplateKind = TemplateKind.entries.firstOrNull { it.name == name } ?: TemplateKind.BLANK
185	}
186	
187	/** Page spec as manifest fields. */
188	internal data class SpecFields(
189	    val kind: String,
190	    val size: String?,
191	    val orientation: String?,
192	    val widthPt: Float?,
193	    val heightPt: Float?,
194	    val origin: String?,
195	) {
196	    fun toSpec(): PageSpec =
197	        when (kind) {
198	            "fixed" -> fixed()
199	            "custom" -> custom()
200	            "infinite" -> PageSpec.Infinite(if (origin == "custom") custom() else fixed())
201	            else -> throw CorruptDataException("unknown page kind '$kind'")
202	        }
203	
204	    private fun fixed(): PageSpec.Fixed {
205	        val paper = PaperSize.entries.firstOrNull { it.name == size } ?: throw CorruptDataException("unknown paper size '$size'")
206	        val orient = if (orientation == "landscape") Orientation.LANDSCAPE else Orientation.PORTRAIT
207	        return PageSpec.Fixed(paper, orient)
208	    }
209	
210	    private fun custom(): PageSpec.Custom {
211	        val w = widthPt
212	        val h = heightPt
213	        corruptIf(w == null || h == null || !(w > 0f && h > 0f)) { "custom page size $w x $h" }
214	        return PageSpec.Custom(w ?: 0f, h ?: 0f)
215	    }
216	
217	    companion object {
218	        fun of(spec: PageSpec): SpecFields =
219	            when (spec) {
220	                is PageSpec.Fixed -> {
221	                    SpecFields(
222	                        "fixed",
223	                        spec.size.name,
224	                        spec.orientation.name.lowercase(),
225	                        spec.widthPt,
226	                        spec.heightPt,
227	                        null,
228	                    )
229	                }
230	
231	                is PageSpec.Custom -> {
232	                    SpecFields("custom", null, null, spec.widthPt, spec.heightPt, null)
233	                }
234	
235	                is PageSpec.Infinite -> {
236	                    of(spec.origin).copy(kind = "infinite", origin = of(spec.origin).kind)
237	                }
238	            }
239	    }
240	}

3	import dev.folio.core.common.FolioFs
4	import dev.folio.core.common.Outcome
5	import java.io.FilterOutputStream
6	import java.io.IOException
7	import java.io.OutputStream
8	
9	/**
10	 * [FolioFs] that simulates a crash or full disk: the next atomic write whose path ends with
11	 * [pathSuffix] throws after [failAfterBytes] bytes. Everything else goes to [delegate].
12	 */
13	class FaultyFolioFs(
14	    private val delegate: FolioFs,
15	    private val pathSuffix: String,
16	) : FolioFs by delegate {
17	    /** Bytes the next matching write may emit before failing; null = no failure armed. Arming resets [fired]. */
18	    var failAfterBytes: Long? = null
19	        set(value) {
20	            field = value
21	            if (value != null) fired = false
22	        }
23	
24	    /** True once the armed failure fired. */
25	    var fired: Boolean = false
26	        private set
27	
28	    override fun writeAtomic(
29	        path: String,
30	        write: (OutputStream) -> Unit,
31	    ): Outcome<Unit> {
32	        val limit = failAfterBytes
33	        if (limit == null || !path.endsWith(pathSuffix)) return delegate.writeAtomic(path, write)
34	        failAfterBytes = null
35	        return delegate.writeAtomic(path) { out -> write(FailingStream(out, limit) { fired = true }) }
36	    }
37	
38	    private class FailingStream(
39	        out: OutputStream,
40	        private var remaining: Long,
41	        private val onFire: () -> Unit,
42	    ) : FilterOutputStream(out) {
43	        override fun write(b: Int) {
44	            consume(1)
45	            out.write(b)
46	        }
47	
48	        override fun write(
49	            b: ByteArray,
50	            off: Int,
51	            len: Int,
52	        ) {
53	            val allowed = minOf(remaining, len.toLong()).toInt()
54	            if (allowed > 0) out.write(b, off, allowed)
55	            consume(len.toLong())
56	        }
57	
58	        private fun consume(n: Long) {
59	            if (n > remaining) {
60	                remaining = 0
61	                onFire()
62	                throw IOException("injected failure")
63	            }
64	            remaining -= n
65	        }
66	    }
67	}

10	/**
11	 * Live updates for folders on screen (09-storage-library.md#scanning): one FileObserver per watched
12	 * folder; relevant events are debounced into one [onChanged] call (the caller runs an incremental scan).
13	 * Main-thread API; events arrive on the observer thread and only schedule work on [scope].
14	 */
15	class LibraryWatcher(
16	    private val root: File,
17	    private val scope: CoroutineScope,
18	    private val debounceMs: Long = DEFAULT_DEBOUNCE_MS,
19	    private val onChanged: suspend () -> Unit,
20	) {
21	    private val observers = HashMap<String, FileObserver>()
22	    private var pending: Job? = null
23	
24	    /** Watches exactly [folders] (library-relative, "" = root). */
25	    fun watch(folders: Set<String>) {
26	        (observers.keys - folders).forEach { observers.remove(it)?.stopWatching() }
27	        (folders - observers.keys).forEach { rel ->
28	            val dir = if (rel.isEmpty()) root else File(root, rel)
29	            val observer =
30	                object : FileObserver(dir, MASK) {
31	                    override fun onEvent(
32	                        event: Int,
33	                        path: String?,
34	                    ) {
35	                        if (isRelevant(path)) schedule()
36	                    }
37	                }
38	            observer.startWatching()
39	            observers[rel] = observer
40	        }
41	    }
42	
43	    /** Stops all observers. */
44	    fun stop() = watch(emptySet())
45	
46	    @Synchronized
47	    private fun schedule() {
48	        pending?.cancel()
49	        pending =
50	            scope.launch {
51	                delay(debounceMs)
52	                onChanged()
53	            }
54	    }
55	
56	    /** Constants and the event filter. */
57	    companion object {
58	        /** Quiet time before a rescan. */
59	        const val DEFAULT_DEBOUNCE_MS = 300L
60	        private const val MASK =
61	            FileObserver.CREATE or FileObserver.CLOSE_WRITE or FileObserver.DELETE or FileObserver.MOVED_FROM or FileObserver.MOVED_TO
62	
63	        /** Hidden names (our temp files, `.trash`, `.folder.json` edits aside) never trigger a rescan. */
64	        fun isRelevant(name: String?): Boolean = !name.isNullOrEmpty() && !name.startsWith(".")

import androidx.room.Room

/** Library in a temp dir, in-memory index, fake clock; everything runs on the test thread. */
abstract class RepositoryTestBase {
    @get:Rule val fs = TempDirFolioFs()

    protected val clock = FakeClock()
    protected lateinit var db: IndexDb
    protected lateinit var scanner: LibraryScanner
    protected lateinit var documents: DocumentRepository
    protected lateinit var library: LibraryRepository

    private val direct = Dispatchers.Unconfined
    protected val dispatchers = FolioDispatchers(direct, direct, direct, direct, direct)

    @Before
    fun setUpRepositories() {
        db = Room.inMemoryDatabaseBuilder(ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext(), IndexDb::class.java).build()
        scanner = LibraryScanner(fs, db, clock)
        documents = DocumentRepository(fs, scanner, db.dao(), clock, dispatchers, ManifestApp("Folio", "test"))
        library = LibraryRepository(fs, scanner, db.dao(), dispatchers, documents)
    }

    @After
    fun closeDb() = db.close()

    protected fun spec(
        title: String,
        folder: String = "",
        pages: Int = 1,
    ) = NewDocumentSpec(folder, title, ModelFixtures.A4, ModelFixtures.LINED_BACKGROUND, pages)

    protected fun file(path: String) = File(fs.root, path)

    protected fun <T> Outcome<T>.orThrow(): T =
        when (this) {
            is Outcome.Success -> value
            is Outcome.Failure -> throw AssertionError(message, cause)
        }
}

package dev.folio.core.storage.index

import androidx.room.Room
import androidx.test.core.app.ApplicationProvider
import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import com.google.common.truth.Truth.assertThat
import dev.folio.core.common.Outcome
import dev.folio.core.format.container.DocumentEntries
import dev.folio.core.format.container.FolioContainerWriter
import dev.folio.core.format.manifest.ManifestApp
import dev.folio.core.model.Document
import dev.folio.core.testing.FakeClock
import dev.folio.core.testing.ModelFixtures
import dev.folio.core.testing.TempDirFolioFs
import kotlinx.collections.immutable.persistentSetOf
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.first
import kotlinx.coroutines.test.runTest
import org.junit.After
import org.junit.Before
import org.junit.Rule
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith
import java.io.File
import kotlin.random.Random

@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class LibraryScannerTest {
    @get:Rule val fs = TempDirFolioFs()

    private val clock = FakeClock()
    private lateinit var db: IndexDb
    private lateinit var scanner: LibraryScanner
    private val random = Random(500)

    @Before
    fun setUp() {
        db = Room.inMemoryDatabaseBuilder(ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext(), IndexDb::class.java).build()
        scanner = LibraryScanner(fs, db, clock)
    }

    @After
    fun tearDown() = db.close()

    @Test
    fun fullScan_500Documents_under3Seconds() =
        runTest {
            repeat(500) { i -> writeDoc("Folder ${i % 10}/Doc $i.folio", "Doc $i", "topic$i kinematics lecture") }
            fs.mkdirs(".trash")
            writeDoc(".trash/123__Hidden.folio", "Hidden", "invisible")

            val start = System.nanoTime()
            val stats = scanner.fullScan()
            val ms = (System.nanoTime() - start) / 1_000_000
            println("full scan of 500 documents: $ms ms")

            assertThat(stats.files).isEqualTo(500)
            assertThat(stats.folders).isEqualTo(10)
            assertThat(db.dao().documentCount()).isEqualTo(500)
            assertThat(ms).isLessThan(3_000)
            val t0 = System.nanoTime()
            assertThat(scanner.incrementalScan().indexed).isEqualTo(0)
            println("incremental scan without changes: ${(System.nanoTime() - t0) / 1_000_000} ms")
        }

    @Test
    fun incrementalScan_detectsAddModifyDeleteMove() =
        runTest {
            writeDoc("A.folio", "Alpha", "first")
            writeDoc("Sub/B.folio", "Beta", "second")
            scanner.fullScan()

            val docId = db.dao().document("A.folio")!!.docId
            writeDoc("C.folio", "Gamma", "third") // add
            writeDoc("A.folio", "Alpha renamed", "first changed, longer body", id = docId) // modify
            File(fs.root, "Sub/B.folio").delete() // delete
            fs.mkdirs("Moved")
            fs.move("A.folio", "Moved/A.folio") // move

            val stats = scanner.incrementalScan()

            assertThat(stats.removed).isEqualTo(2)
            val dao = db.dao()
            assertThat(dao.document("C.folio")!!.title).isEqualTo("Gamma")
            assertThat(dao.document("Sub/B.folio")).isNull()
            assertThat(dao.document("A.folio")).isNull()
            val moved = dao.document("Moved/A.folio")!!
            assertThat(moved.title).isEqualTo("Alpha renamed")
            assertThat(moved.docId).isEqualTo(docId)
            assertThat(moved.folderPath).isEqualTo("Moved")
            assertThat(dao.folders().first().map { it.path }).containsExactly("Moved", "Sub")
        }

    @Test
    fun search_prefixTokens_allMustMatch() =
        runTest {
            writeDoc("P.folio", "Physics Kinematics", "velocity and acceleration")
            writeDoc("M.folio", "Maths", "vectors and velocity")
            writeDoc("G.folio", "Größen", "Überblick")
            scanner.fullScan()
            val dao = db.dao()

            assertThat(dao.search(FtsQuery.of("velo")!!).map { it.path }).containsExactly("P.folio", "M.folio")
            assertThat(dao.search(FtsQuery.of("velo kinem")!!).map { it.path }).containsExactly("P.folio")
            assertThat(dao.search(FtsQuery.of("über")!!).map { it.path }).containsExactly("G.folio")
            assertThat(FtsQuery.of("  --  ")).isNull()
        }

    @Test
    fun scan_tagsFavoritesAndCorruptFiles() =
        runTest {
            writeDoc("T.folio", "Tagged", "x", tags = setOf("school", "physics"), favorite = true)
            File(fs.root, "Broken.folio").writeText("not a zip")
            scanner.fullScan()
            val dao = db.dao()

            assertThat(dao.allTags().first()).containsExactly("physics", "school")
            assertThat(dao.favorites().first().map { it.path }).containsExactly("T.folio")
            assertThat(dao.document("Broken.folio")!!.status).isEqualTo(DocStatus.CORRUPT)
            assertThat(dao.document("Broken.folio")!!.title).isEqualTo("Broken")
        }

    @Test
    fun scan_staleTempFile_deletedFreshKept() =
        runTest {
            val stale = File(fs.root, ".Doc.folio.123.tmp").apply { writeText("partial") }
            stale.setLastModified(clock.nowMs() - 11 * 60 * 1000)
            val fresh = File(fs.root, ".Other.folio.456.tmp").apply { writeText("partial") }
            fresh.setLastModified(clock.nowMs())
            scanner.incrementalScan()
            assertThat(stale.exists()).isFalse()
            assertThat(fresh.exists()).isTrue()
        }

    @Test
    fun watcher_ignoresHiddenNames() {
        assertThat(LibraryWatcher.isRelevant(".Doc.folio.1.tmp")).isFalse()
        assertThat(LibraryWatcher.isRelevant(null)).isFalse()
        assertThat(LibraryWatcher.isRelevant("Doc.folio")).isTrue()
        assertThat(LibraryWatcher.isRelevant("New folder")).isTrue()
    }

    private fun writeDoc(
        path: String,
        title: String,
        text: String,
        tags: Set<String> = emptySet(),
        favorite: Boolean = false,
        id: String = ModelFixtures.randomId(random),
    ) {
        val base =
            ModelFixtures.document(
                pages = listOf(ModelFixtures.randomPage(random, 2)),
                flows = listOf(ModelFixtures.flow(ModelFixtures.randomId(random), text)),
                id = id,
            )
        val doc: Document =
            base.copy(
                meta = base.meta.copy(title = title, favorite = favorite, tags = persistentSetOf<String>().addAll(tags)),
            )
        val result = fs.writeAtomic(path) { out -> FolioContainerWriter.write(out, DocumentEntries.all(doc, ManifestApp(), emptyMap())) }
        check(result is Outcome.Success) { result }
    }
}

package dev.folio.core.storage.work

import com.google.common.truth.Truth.assertThat
import com.google.common.truth.Truth.assertWithMessage
import dev.folio.core.common.Outcome
import dev.folio.core.format.container.DocumentEntries
import dev.folio.core.storage.work.WorkFixture.orThrow
import dev.folio.core.testing.FakeClock
import dev.folio.core.testing.FaultyFolioFs
import dev.folio.core.testing.ModelFixtures
import dev.folio.core.testing.TempDirFolioFs
import org.junit.Rule
import org.junit.Test
import java.io.File
import java.time.ZoneOffset
import kotlin.random.Random

class PackerTest {
    @get:Rule val fs = TempDirFolioFs()

    private val clock = FakeClock()
    private val source = "School/Physics.folio"

    @Test
    fun pack_injectedFailureAtRandomOffsets_neverCorruptsTarget() {
        val library = FaultyFolioFs(fs.sub("library"), ".folio")
        val app = fs.sub("app")
        val doc = WorkFixture.document()
        WorkFixture.writeFolio(library, source, doc)
        val targetFile = File(fs.root, "library/$source")
        val store = WorkingCopyStore(app, library)
        val packer = Packer(library, app, clock, ZoneOffset.UTC)
        val random = Random(SEED)
        repeat(100) { run ->
            val before = targetFile.readBytes()
            val copy = store.open(source).orThrow()
            val page = ModelFixtures.randomPage(random, 1 + random.nextInt(8)).copy(id = doc.pages[run % 3].id)
            copy.writeEntries(mapOf(DocumentEntries.encodePage(page))).orThrow()
            library.failAfterBytes = random.nextLong(0, before.size + 4096L)
            val failed = packer.pack(copy)
            if (library.fired) {
                assertWithMessage("seed=$SEED run=$run").that(failed).isInstanceOf(Outcome.Failure::class.java)
                assertWithMessage("seed=$SEED run=$run target unchanged").that(targetFile.readBytes()).isEqualTo(before)
                WorkFixture.readFolio(targetFile)
                assertThat(copy.isDirty).isTrue()
            }
            library.failAfterBytes = null
            packer.pack(copy).orThrow()
            val after = WorkFixture.readFolio(targetFile)
            assertWithMessage("seed=$SEED run=$run")
                .that(
                    after.pageBodies
                        .getValue(page.id)
                        .objects.size,
                ).isEqualTo(page.objects.size)
            assertThat(copy.isDirty).isFalse()
        }
        assertThat(File(fs.root, "library/School").list()!!.toList()).containsExactly("Physics.folio")
    }

    @Test
    fun pack_firstPack_keepsBackupOfOpenedVersion() {
        val library = fs.sub("library")
        val app = fs.sub("app")
        val doc = WorkFixture.document()
        WorkFixture.writeFolio(library, source, doc)
        val original = File(fs.root, "library/$source").readBytes()
        val copy = WorkingCopyStore(app, library).open(source).orThrow()
        copy.writeEntries(mapOf("flows/x.md" to "x".toByteArray())).orThrow()
        assertThat(Packer(library, app, clock).pack(copy).orThrow()).isEqualTo(PackResult.Packed(source))
        assertThat(File(fs.root, "app/backup/${doc.meta.id.value}.folio").readBytes()).isEqualTo(original)
        assertThat(copy.base.backupDone).isTrue()
    }

    @Test
    fun pack_clean_doesNothing() {
        val library = fs.sub("library")
        val app = fs.sub("app")
        WorkFixture.writeFolio(library, source, WorkFixture.document())
        val copy = WorkingCopyStore(app, library).open(source).orThrow()
        assertThat(Packer(library, app, clock).pack(copy).orThrow()).isEqualTo(PackResult.Clean)
    }

    @Test
    fun safeFileName_replacesReservedCharacters() {
        assertThat(Packer.safeFileName("Physics: Week 1/2 <draft>?")).isEqualTo("Physics- Week 1-2 -draft--")
        assertThat(Packer.safeFileName(".hidden")).isEqualTo("hidden")
    }

    private companion object {
        const val SEED = 5150L
    }
}
